new_roles.title: Director of Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
Director of Manufacturing

**POSITION SUMMARY**
====================

Weaver Popcorn is seeking an experienced manufacturing leader to direct the **Malden, Missouri** operation and strengthen safety, quality, service, cost performance, throughput, and associate development. The Director of Manufacturing provides strategic and hands-on leadership for plant operations, maintenance, sanitation, scheduling, grower partnership, and continuous improvement while ensuring reliable execution of annual operating priorities.

This leader will establish clear performance expectations, develop plant leadership and frontline capability, optimize equipment and labor effectiveness, and partner across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement to deliver sustainable operational and financial results.

**HOW WILL YOU HELP US GROW?**
==============================

**Manufacturing & Operational Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Lead the Malden manufacturing operation with accountability for safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, sanitation, labor effectiveness, and overall plant performance.
* Establish clear operational standards, performance goals, equipment expectations, and operating cost objectives aligned with the annual plan.
* Drive reliable production output and efficient growth by ensuring the right equipment, staffing, operating systems, and performance measures are in place.
* Lead regular operating reviews with plant leadership to evaluate productivity, downtime, quality, staffing, schedule attainment, and corrective actions.
* Ensure manufacturing systems, procedures, and policies are consistently deployed, understood, and followed across assigned operations.
* Align internal manufacturing capabilities with customer needs, production schedules, raw-material availability, and growth expectations.

**Safety, Quality & Food Manufacturing Compliance**
---------------------------------------------------

* Provide visible leadership for a safe workplace and hold leaders accountable for proactive hazard identification, corrective action, training, and compliance.
* Partner closely with Quality leadership to ensure compliance with food safety and quality requirements, including HACCP, GMPs, sanitation standards, product controls, and applicable regulatory and customer requirements.
* Support disciplined investigation and sustainable corrective action for safety events, quality deviations, operational failures, customer concerns, and recurring performance issues.
* Ensure plant practices support audit readiness, traceability, sanitation effectiveness, and consistent production of safe, conforming product.
* Reinforce the authority and responsibility to stop or correct work when safety, food safety, quality, or regulatory requirements are not being met.

**Continuous Improvement, Reliability & Capital**
-------------------------------------------------

* Deploy Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, yield, reliability, labor efficiency, and cost performance.
* Identify operational failures and constraints, establish root causes, implement corrective actions, and verify sustained effectiveness.
* Develop and maintain meaningful manufacturing KPIs and equipment-efficiency measures that support timely, fact-based decisions.
* Partner with Maintenance and plant leaders to improve equipment reliability, preventive maintenance effectiveness, space utilization, and production capacity.
* Jointly establish capital expenditure priorities and lead effective execution of approved capital and process-improvement projects.
* Challenge existing practices, standardize successful improvements, and build continuous-improvement capability throughout the operation.

**Grower, Supply Chain & Cross-Functional Partnership**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Collaborate with Field Operations to support grower relationships, contracted acreage plans, raw-material supply, and growth objectives.
* Partner with Supply Chain and plant scheduling teams to balance customer requirements, inventory, capacity, labor, and raw-material availability.
* Work with Finance and Information Technology to strengthen business processes, operating data, management reporting, budgeting, and decision-support tools.
* Contribute the manufacturing perspective to companywide initiatives led by Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Quality, and other functional leaders.
* Communicate operational risks, priorities, tradeoffs, and performance clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**
------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop plant leaders and assigned functional leaders; establish clear goals, accountabilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Build a culture of excellence, ownership, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement at every level of the operation.
* Develop internal talent, strengthen succession readiness, and partner with Human Resources to recruit and retain a capable workforce.
* Build associate competency through effective training, qualification, coaching, and skills-development programs.
* Use a visible, participative leadership style that communicates direction, listens for understanding, addresses conflict directly, and earns followership.

**WHAT DO YOU NEED TO HAVE?**
=============================

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 10 years in a Plant Manager or comparable senior manufacturing leadership role; food or agricultural processing experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success applying Lean manufacturing, Statistical Process Control, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving methods to improve throughput, equipment efficiency, labor productivity, yield, and cost performance.
* Experience leading workplace safety, food manufacturing quality systems, sanitation, GMPs, HACCP-based programs, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Proven financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L accountability, capital prioritization, and analysis of manufacturing KPIs and cost drivers.
* Demonstrated success developing leaders, strengthening organizational capability, managing change, and building accountability in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
* Ability to travel regionally approximately 15% and remain available outside normal business hours when operational needs require support.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Leadership experience in popcorn, corn, grain, ingredient, food processing, or a related agricultural manufacturing environment.
* Experience leading capital projects, technical teams, maintenance-reliability programs, and high-engagement employee relations.
* Formal training or certification in Lean, Six Sigma, safety, continuous improvement, or project leadership.
* Experience partnering directly with growers or agricultural supply networks.

**WHERE & WHEN WILL YOU WORK?**
===============================

This role operates across office, agricultural, warehouse, and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday; however, the Director of Manufacturing must be available outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when safety, quality, customer, staffing, equipment, or other operational needs require support. Regional travel of approximately 15% is expected, with additional travel based on business needs.

**WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?**
================================

* Strong, sustained performance in safety, quality, service, cost, throughput, schedule attainment, and customer satisfaction.
* Improved equipment reliability, operating efficiency, labor effectiveness, yield, and cost performance supported by clear KPIs.
* Consistent execution of manufacturing, sanitation, food safety, quality, and operating standards.
* Disciplined problem solving that reduces recurring failures and produces measurable, sustained improvement.
* A capable and accountable plant leadership team with clear goals, stronger bench strength, and active development plans.
* Effective partnership across Quality, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, and Continuous Improvement.
* Credible, visible leadership that builds ownership, engagement, and confidence throughout the Malden operation.

**HOW WILL WE HELP YOU GROW?**
==============================

* Competitive compensation.
* Three weeks of paid time off in the first year.
* 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of employee deferrals up to 10%.
* Health, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance beginning the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.
* Education reimbursement of up to $15,000 per year.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
================================

Weaver Popcorn is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and associates. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

*The role responsibilities are many, various, and not limited to those written in this document.*

new_roles.title: Director of S&OP and Production Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
At Taconic Biosciences, operational excellence fuels scientific discovery. We're seeking an experienced Operations Planning leader to strengthen the connection between commercial demand and operational execution, ensuring our teams deliver exceptional results for customers worldwide. If you're passionate about strategic planning, continuous improvement, and leading high-performing teams, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

**The Location:** This role is a primarily at home/remote but will have ad hoc needs to come onsite. Average monthly time on-site is 5% - 10%. A candidate residing within 2 hours of Albany, NY or Germantown, NY is preferred but not required.

**The Pay Range**: $120,000 - $170,000 annually. *Exact annual base salary may vary based on several factors. These factors include, but are not limited to: geographic location, experience, training, education, and local market conditions.*

**The Schedule:** Monday - Friday, core business hours.

**What we offer:**

* Insurance within 30 days or less which includes options for medical, dental, vision, pet insurance and more!
* 20 days paid time off plus 6 additional holidays and 1 floating holiday
* Work life balance
* 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Career advancement opportunities
* Commitment to training and providing you with the skills you need for success
* All employees receive access to 24/7 telemedicine (including mental health), short- and long-term disability and life insurance

**The Role:** 
The role's objective is to strengthen alignment between Operations and the Commercial areas, making sure internal and external customers' expectations are met, as well as constantly improving efficiency & cost to achieve business financial commitments. 
 
**Core Responsibilities:**

* Manage and develop the SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning) process across the business
* Ensure optimal communication among Commercial & Operations regarding demand and production commitments
* Develop and maintain updated Operational Capacity numbers, and timely detect capacity expansion needs
* Coordinator efforts to develop Operation's yearly budgets (AOP) and forecast updates
* Work closely with global Commercial Demand stakeholders (sales, marketing, R&D), Procurement, Animal Production and Logistics to align Operation's resources to demand
* Identify and highlight to OLT (Operations Leadership Team) any short-, mid-, and long-term resource needs based on commercial demand plans and changes
* Develop a LEAN Production culture that is constantly looking for improvement results in all metrics that matter considering, but not limited to: People, Safety, Quality, Animal Welfare, Customer Services and Cost
* Detect, develop and execute continuous improvement projects to optimize the use of Operation's resources; (5Ms - Men & Women, Machines, Materials, Minutes (time and schedules), Methods)
* Develop and implement success metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement
* Lead, manage and develop all members of the Operations Planning Team

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in industrial engineering or similar required, Master's degree is desirable
* Experience in the management of a professional staff and senior-level decision making
* Extensive experience in a specialized field, with responsibility for strategic technical direction, high-impact problem-solving, or enterprise-level initiatives
* 10+ years of relevant experience and/or training required
* Experience in Industrial Production/Manufacturing. Laboratory animal production would be desirable.
* Skill in designing, implementing, and coordinating projects.
* Experience in making strategic decisions or recommendations for improving or changing organizational policies, procedures and processes.
* Structured, well organized analytical thinking.
* 10+ years in any area of Industrial Operations areas.
* 6+ years in Production / Manufacturing
* 5+ years leading teams & experience in Change Management
* 3+ years in S&OP process including IBP (Integrated Business Planning) 
 Other Desirable Experience & Competencies:
* 3+ years managing Operations / Manufacturing Costs
* 3+ Years Project management experience (PMO)
* Knowledge and Practical experience with Forecasting Statistical Methodologies
* APICS certification
* AI experienced applied to S&OP
* Multi site / Global responsibility.

**Allergen Disclosure:**

Due to the nature of the work performed at Taconic, employees may be exposed to allergens in the workplace, even if their positions do not involve the direct handling of animals or animal bedding. While individuals with preexisting allergies and/or asthma may be particularly sensitive to these exposures, anyone can experience a reaction.

**Physical Requirements & Work Environment:**

The work is sedentary. Typically, the employee may sit comfortably to do the work, with some walking; standing; bending; carrying of items such as papers, books, small parts; driving an automobile; etc. No special physical demands are required to perform the work.

**About Us:** 
With a history of over 70 years of excellence, Taconic Biosciences is a global team of the best problem solvers in the industry. We partner with our clients to develop winning research strategies that accelerate the discoveries for prevention and treatment of disease.

Taconic employees all over the world show up every day to deliver the best solutions for our clients while caring for ourselves, each other, and especially our animals. If you are a respectful, compassionate individual with a can-do attitude and a desire to do the right thing, we want you to join us!

**Better Together at Taconic** 
Awareness, Action, & Respect. Taconic Biosciences is taking an active and intentional role in fostering a company culture that values and appreciates the uniqueness of all individuals, by promoting fairness and equity. Being you is what allows you to bring your best self to work. We are committed to making Taconic a safe and fair workplace for everyone. We are better together. 
 
Taconic Biosciences is an equal-opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status, and all other categories protected by law.

new_roles.title: Operations Director
new_roles.description:
**Build Your Career. Lead With Precision.**

Nammo Perry is a center of excellence for the design, development and production of munitions and pyrotechnic products for the U.S. Department of Defense. Nammo employees working at the Florida site manufacture all types of 40mm low and high velocity ammunition; pyrotechnic marking; signaling and tactical illumination devices; battlefield effects training simulators; demolition charges; hand grenade fuzes; and other ammunition components. Additionally, they provide load, assemble, and pack (LAP) services for large caliber direct-fire ammunition.

The **Director of Operations** provides strategic and operational leadership for manufacturing, energetic material processing, maintenance, and facilities functions across the Nammo Perry facility. Reporting directly to the Site President/General Manager this position is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and reliable operations while supporting organizational growth production readiness and long-term business objectives.

The Director of Operations leads a multidisciplinary organization through direct-report managers responsible for Energetic Operations, Production Operations, Maintenance, and Facilities. These functions collectively support the site's manufacturing capabilities, critical infrastructure, equipment reliability, and operational continuity. The Director of Operations is expected to establish clear operational priorities, develop strong management teams, drive accountability, and foster a culture of continuous improvement grounded in Nammo’s core values of Dedication, Care, and Precision.

**Unique Benefits Designed with Care:**

* Monday - Thursday work week working 10-hour days
* Relocation assistance provided
* 401(K) with a 6% company match
* 100% Employer-Paid Employee Only Medical Plan Option
* Employer Health Saving Account Contributions
* Two week’s vacation, one-week sick pay, and nine paid holidays

**What You’ll Do: Precision in Action**

**Strategic Operations Leadership**

* Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with organizational objectives, production requirements, and long-term business growth.
* Provide leadership and accountability across manufacturing, energetic operations, maintenance, and facilities ensuring effective coordination and operational performance.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to safety, quality, delivery costs, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with site leadership to evaluate operational priorities, resource allocation, capital investments, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

**Manufacturing and Energetic Operations**

* Oversee production operations across Large Caliber Systems and Aerospace Propulsion business units ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant manufacturing activities.
* Provide strategic oversight of energetic material blending and processing operations, ensuring alignment with production requirements and established safety standards.
* Drive manufacturing performance through effective capacity planning workforce utilization production scheduling and operational discipline.
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, supply chain, and program management to support customer commitments, resolve operational challenges, and improve manufacturing capabilities.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels and resource planning to meet programmatic needs while maintaining cost initiatives.
* Establish leader standard work directives to guide day-to-day operations.

**Maintenance and Facilities Management**

* Provide strategic oversight of maintenance operations including electrical and control systems, machining, mechanical maintenance, and equipment reliability.
* Lead facilities management functions supporting site infrastructure, facilities engineering, building systems, preventative maintenance, and essential site services.
* Establish and deconflict priorities for preventative maintenance, equipment availability, infrastructure improvements, and operational continuity.
* Support capital improvements, equipment upgrades, and facility investments necessary to sustain and expand manufacturing operations.

**Safety, Quality and Regulatory Compliance**

* Champion a safety-first culture ensuring operational adherence to applicable environmental health, explosive safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Quality to maintain process discipline, product conformity, risk management, and compliance with established management systems.
* Drive accountability for identifying and addressing operational risks, safety concerns, non-conformances, and continuous improvement opportunities.

**Financial Performance and People Leadership**

* Develop and manage operational budgets, labor resources, capital expenditures, and cost improvement initiatives.
* Lead, coach, and develop direct-report managers while establishing clear expectations for performance, accountability, and organizational effectiveness.Partner with People and Culture on workforce planning, succession planning, leadership development, and employee engagement.

**What Dedicated Teammates Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration or related field. Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing operations or industrial leadership.
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience including demonstrated success leading managers or multidisciplinary operational teams.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, energetic materials, chemical processing, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex manufacturing operations, develop operational strategies, manage budgets, and drive performance improvements.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, industrial safety, equipment reliability, and operational excellence principles.
* Proven leadership, communication, problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

*Preferred Qualification:*

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management or related discipline.
* Direct experience in defense manufacturing, energetic material processing, ammunition production, or aerospace propulsion.
* Experience overseeing multiple operational functions including production, maintenance, facilities, and engineering support.
* Familiarity with explosive safety requirements and defense industry regulations.
* Experience with ISO 9001 and AS9100, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or comparable operational excellence methodologies.

*Leadership Competencies*

* Aligns operational capabilities and resources with business objectives and long-term growth.
* Drives performance improvements in safety, quality, delivery cost, and reliability.
* Build strong management teams and promotes accountability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Demonstrate sound judgment, hazard awareness, and commitment to disciplined operations,
* Build effective partnerships across departments and business units
* Leads teams through expansion, organizational growth, and evolving operational requirements.

**Our Woking Conditions and Requirements**

* This position operates in both office and industrial manufacturing environments and requires regular interaction with production areas, maintenance, operations, and facility infrastructure.
* The role may involve prolonged periods of sitting, standing, and walking, including navigating manufacturing facilities and operational work areas.
* Employees must comply with applicable safety, security, and environmental requirements including the use of required personal protective equipment (PPE) when entering designated areas.
* The position may require occasional domestic or international travel and flexibility to support operational needs outside standard business hours.
* Must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

*Our values are the fundamental principles guiding the way we do business and interact with stakeholders.*

***DEDICATION:*** *We are enthusiastic and creative, always searching for the best solutions.* 
***PRECISION:*** *We are reliable and accurate in our technology, processes and business.* 
***CARE:*** *We are inclusive and open-minded, always encouraging team spirit and cooperation.*

*Nammo and its subsidiaries provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

**\*\*Note\*\*: Due to US Export Control laws and regulations; applicants selected for employment must show proof of a U.S. Person status before employment may begin.**

new_roles.title: Supply Chain & Production Director
new_roles.description:
**Supply Chain & Production Director**

**Bil-Jax, Inc.**

**Location:** Archbold, Ohio (On-Site)

Note: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

 

**Bil-Jax, Inc., a member of the Haulotte Group, is seeking an experienced Supply Chain & Production Director to lead manufacturing and supply chain operations at our Archbold, Ohio facility.** Reporting directly to the Vice President & General Manager, this key leadership role is responsible for manufacturing, procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics, and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP). The successful candidate will lead a multi-year factory modernization initiative focused on automation, operational excellence, and scalable growth while partnering with production, engineering, sourcing, and commercial teams to improve productivity, delivery performance, and profitability across the business.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

**Factory Modernization & Automation**

* Lead the development and execution of a long-term automation strategy that improves manufacturing efficiency, increases throughput, and reduces overall production costs.
* Manage capital investment projects from concept through implementation, including equipment selection, vendor management, installation, commissioning, and performance validation.
* Partner with Engineering and IT teams to integrate new manufacturing technologies and digital solutions that improve visibility, reporting, and operational decision-making.

 

**Production Planning & Operational Excellence**

* Optimize production scheduling and resource allocation across a complex manufacturing environment with approximately 2,000 active SKUs while maintaining high levels of quality, efficiency, and on-time delivery.
* Develop and implement processes that improve the flow of work-in-process material and eliminate bottlenecks between fabrication, welding, painting, and assembly operations.
* Lead the monthly Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process in collaboration with cross-functional leaders to align customer demand, production capacity, inventory levels, and business objectives.

 

**Supply Chain & Procurement Leadership**

* Develop sourcing strategies for steel, purchased components, and other critical materials while building strong supplier partnerships and mitigating supply chain risk.
* Establish inventory management practices that improve inventory accuracy, increase inventory turns, and maintain service levels required to support customers and production operations.
* Oversee warehousing, inbound logistics, and outbound freight activities to ensure efficient material flow and cost-effective distribution.

 

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Drive organizational change by leading the transition toward a more automated and technically advanced manufacturing environment while developing and upskilling existing team members.
* Provide leadership and direction to Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Production Supervisors, and other operational teams while working collaboratively with Maintenance, Safety, Shipping, and Site Leadership.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement by ensuring compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

 

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience within a manufacturing environment, including at least 5 years in a senior operations leadership role such as Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or Director of Operations.
* Demonstrated success within structural steel fabrication, sheet metal fabrication, machining, heavy equipment manufacturing, or a related industrial environment.
* Proven experience implementing manufacturing automation, robotics, or automated production cells.
* Experience leading operations within a manufacturing organization ranging from approximately $30M to $100M in annual revenue.
* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or a related field.

 

**Preferred Skills**

* Deep understanding of metal fabrication, welding, machining, and assembly processes.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong financial and business acumen with experience managing operational budgets and capital expenditures.
* Experience utilizing ERP systems in a manufacturing environment, preferably Epicor.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and change management skills.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
Linde Advanced Material Technologies Inc.

**Plant Manager**

Ellisville, MS, United States | req34514

**What you will enjoy doing\***

* Lead the Ellisville manufacturing operation with full accountability for Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC), while ensuring customer commitments and business objectives are consistently achieved
* Build and develop a high-performing leadership team by setting clear expectations, coaching managers and supervisors, strengthening accountability, and developing organizational capability and succession
* You will drive the PGT Lean Operating System through daily management, leader standard work, visual management, structured problem solving, standard work, and continuous improvement
* Be a visible leader on the shop floor, working with teams at the source to identify problems, remove barriers, strengthen process discipline, and ensure corrective actions address root causes and are sustained
* Improve operational performance and reliability by strengthening equipment performance, first-pass yield, flow, WIP, productivity, capacity, and on-time delivery while maintaining uncompromising safety and quality standards
* Develop and execute the site strategy, aligning workforce, training, equipment, materials, capital, and capacity with customer demand, growth priorities, and long-term business requirements
* Own the financial performance of the facility, including budgets, labor efficiency, overtime, productivity, cost improvement, operational spending, and capital priorities
* Also, you will lead cross-functionally and create a strong site culture, partnering with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, EHS, Human Resources, and Finance while fostering respect, transparency, employee engagement, urgency, and continuous improvement

**What makes you great**

* You have a Bachelor’s degree with ten (10) or more years of related manufacturing experience, a Master’s degree with eight (8) or more years, a PhD with five (5) or more years, or sixteen (16) or more years of directly related manufacturing experience
* Further you have significant manufacturing leadership experience with accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, and operational results
* You have successfully led leaders, including managers and frontline supervisors, and know how to build capability rather than becoming the organization’s primary problem solver
* You have demonstrated experience applying Lean principles, daily management, standard work, and structured problem solving to deliver measurable operational improvement
* And you bring strong financial and business acumen, with experience managing budgets, labor, productivity, operating costs, and capital priorities
* Experience in aerospace, coatings, special processes, precision manufacturing, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment is strongly preferred
* You are comfortable leading change in a complex manufacturing environment and can move effectively between strategy, data, the shop floor, and customer and business priorities
* Most importantly, you lead with humility, accountability, transparency, respect for people, and a bias for action, while developing others and creating sustainable systems for success

**Why you will love working with us**

Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet.
 
 
Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals & energy, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra-high-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state-of-the-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.

**What we offer you!**

At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless. 
 
Linde offers competitive compensation and an outstanding benefits package. Enjoy access to health, dental, disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and vacation, 401(k) matching, pension benefits, an employee discount program, and opportunities for educational and professional growth. Additional compensation may vary depending on the position and organizational level. Build your future with us while making an impact every day!

**Have we inspired you? Let´s talk about it**

We are looking forward to receiving your complete application.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law. 
 
Linde Advanced Material Technologies Inc. abides by applicable export control laws including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) in accordance with the company's export control procedures. As such, persons considered for this position must be either a U.S. Citizen, Permanent Resident (green card holder) or otherwise classifiable as a U.S. person under relevant regulations. 
 
Linde Advanced Material Technologies Inc. acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development. 
 

* The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Therefore employees assigned may be required to perform additional job tasks required by the manager.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations - Aiken, SC
new_roles.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

The Director of Operations is responsible for the activities of manufacturing, purchasing, quality, planning (supply chain), and project management of the organization and aids in formulating and administering organization policies.

#LI-SL1

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

* Participating in formulating/administering company policies and developing long range goals/objectives.
* Directing/coordinating activities of the responsible departments on a day-to-day basis to ensure that daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual objectives are met.
* Ensuring internal auditing for compliance with the ISO standards applicable.
* Driving cost reduction (productivity) planning and execution in accordance with the financial plan.
* Providing authorization for funds to ensure responsible fiduciary spending in accordance with financial policies.
* Reviewing/analyzing activities related to costs, operations, CAPEX, and forecast data to determine progress toward financial goals and objectives and considering the long-range impact of growing the business and adjusting actions to ensure compliance.
* Overseeing the budget/forecast processes as well as ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance.
* Conferring with other senior personnel to review achievements and discuss required changes in goals or objectives resulting from current status/conditions.
* Developing plans and executing actions to meet the decision upon actions.
* Providing oversight and coordination to other business in Operations related matters to drive consistency among the businesses.
* Participating in due diligence process as requested.
* Developing succession planning strategies in coordination with HR to ensure continuation of leadership/individual contributor roles going forward.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* Master’s Degree in Business Administration (required)
* 20+ years of relevant operations experience (required)
* 20+ years of experience as a Senior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or a similar role, preferably in a heavy manufacturing environment with multi-site responsibility
* 10+ years of experience with TPM and SAP
* Welding, Fabricating, Warehouse & Logistics experience
* Operational Excellence or Lean Certification
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing
* Staff development and engagement skills
* Bi-lingual Spanish/English preferred

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
**Quality Director**

**Aerospace Manufacturing | Senior Leadership Team**

**About Columbia Manufacturing**

Columbia Manufacturing, a member of Collective Manufacturing Group, produces complex fabricated components and assemblies for leading aerospace and power generation engine programs. We are committed to delivering safe, reliable, and compliant products while fostering a culture built on integrity, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Quality Director who will strengthen our quality culture, develop our people, and help ensure we remain a trusted partner to our customers.

**Position Summary**

The Quality Director is a member of the senior leadership team responsible for ensuring Columbia Manufacturing consistently delivers products that meet customer, regulatory, and internal quality requirements.

This role goes beyond compliance. We are seeking a leader who combines sound judgment, ethical decision-making, objective interpretation of requirements, and strong cross-functional leadership. The successful candidate will guide the organization through customer requirements, industry standards, and business challenges while ensuring quality and integrity remain at the center of every decision. We believe strong teams produce strong results, and cultural fit is as important as technical expertise.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who earns trust, develops people, and works effectively with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, and customers. We value practical experience as highly as formal education and welcome candidates who have built their careers through hands-on manufacturing and quality leadership roles.

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead the Quality Management System**

* Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System.
* Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and aerospace requirements.
* Promote quality ownership and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

**Guide Quality Decisions**

* Interpret customer specifications, drawings, contractual requirements, and industry standards.
* Provide guidance when requirements are unclear, conflicting, or open to interpretation.
* Lead investigations, corrective actions, and nonconformance resolution using sound judgment and risk-based decision making.

**Partner with Customers and Regulatory Bodies**

* Serve as the primary quality representative to customers, auditors, and regulatory agencies.
* Build trusted relationships and lead internal, customer, and third-party audits.

**Develop People and Culture**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the Quality team.
* Build a high-performing organization through coaching, accountability, and succession planning.
* Foster collaboration and an environment where employees are comfortable raising concerns.
* Promote a culture where doing the right thing is always more important than meeting a schedule.

**Contribute to Business Success**

* Partner with Operations and Leadership to improve performance, reduce risk, strengthen organizational alignment, and support growth.
* Balance customer expectations, business priorities, and compliance requirements without compromising quality standards.
* Exercise independent quality authority and be willing to stop production or shipment when requirements have not been met.

**What We’re Looking For**

We recognize that great leaders come from many backgrounds. Candidates may have developed through engineering, manufacturing, inspection, quality systems, operations, military service, trade programs, or traditional degree pathways. Equivalent combinations of education, military training, trade experience, and hands-on manufacturing or quality leadership experience will be fully considered.

We are less concerned with how you gained your experience and more interested in your ability to lead people, interpret requirements, make sound decisions, and uphold quality standards under pressure.

Successful candidates will typically possess:

* Experience leading quality functions within aerospace, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industries.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, customer requirements, and specification interpretation.
* Demonstrated ethical leadership, sound decision-making, and the ability to uphold standards under pressure.
* Proven success leading teams and collaborating across departments.
* Strong communication skills and experience working with customers, auditors, and senior leadership.
* Continuous improvement mindset and practical problem-solving ability.

**Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with aerospace quality standards such as AS9100, AS9110, AS13100, NADCAP, or customer-specific requirements.
* Experience supporting OEM customers such as GE Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, or similar organizations.
* Quality certifications or advanced education are valued but not required.

**Why This Role Matters**

The Quality Director plays a critical role in protecting our customers, our employees, and our reputation. This leader helps ensure that every product we build meets requirements and that every decision we make reflects our commitment to integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**If you are a leader who values ethics, teamwork, sound judgment, and building strong people and processes, we encourage you to apply.**

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations
new_roles.description:
**Who We Are**

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at www.sens-usa.com.

**View the SENS Product Catalog**

**Summary**

The Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations leads the people, processes, and systems that maintain accurate inventory and reliable material flow across Stored Energy Systems (SENS) manufacturing operations. Based at Disc Drive headquarters, this role leads teams and team members across all SENS locations on first shift (days) and second shift (evenings). The role oversees receiving, warehousing, inventory control, material handling, production replenishment, kitting, inter-factory transportation, shipping, and freight coordination, while developing teams and operating capacity to support production continuity, customer deliveries, and growth.

**Responsibilities**

Leadership and Operating Performance

* Establish consistent material handling and inventory management standards, performance expectations, and accountability across all locations.
* Develop supervisors and team leaders through coaching, training, performance management, and succession planning.
* Own Warehouse Operations staffing plans and coordinate coverage, priorities, and escalation processes across all locations and both shifts to support production needs.
* Promote safe material handling and consistent workplace practices in partnership with the Environmental Health and Safety team.

Inventory Accuracy and Control

* Own inventory accuracy and control standards across SENS inventory locations, including inventory held at partner locations.
* Establish consistent receiving, put-away, picking, transfer, issue, return, and reconciliation processes in Infor SyteLine. Oversee receipt processing for non-inventory purchases.
* Lead cycle counting, inventory discrepancy investigations, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Maintain material identification, traceability, first-in, first-out practices, and segregation of restricted or nonconforming inventory.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance on inventory reconciliation and actions to improve inventory health, supporting Procurement’s ownership of inventory turns, safety stock levels, and excess and obsolete inventory.
* Lead preparation and execution of annual physical inventories at all SENS locations.

Production Material Flow

* Lead production material delivery, including stock picking, replenishment of point-of-use inventory areas, scheduled material delivery routes, and kanban replenishment parameters. Align execution with sales, inventory, and operations planning (SIOP) and production schedules.
* Develop and implement scalable assembly-phase kitting processes for configure-to-order and engineer-to-order products. Ensure kit accuracy, completeness, alignment with current revisions, staging, and return of unused materials.
* Coordinate material priorities, shortage escalations, and decisions about incomplete kits with Planning, Production, and Procurement.
* Establish visual management and kanban replenishment processes from kitting through delivery to production lines.

Transportation, Shipping, and Freight

* Own inter-factory transportation and inventory transfers, movement of finished products to shipping, and return flows for empty bins, carts, and protective packing materials.
* Lead local shipping operations and centralized inbound and outbound freight execution, coordinating with Planning & Fulfillment and Order Management to support on-time, complete customer shipments.
* Manage freight and premium freight costs against budget and maintain transportation contingency plans to support production continuity and customer deliveries.

Capacity and Continuous Improvement

* Translate production forecasts into logistics capacity plans. Lead warehouse and material-flow readiness for factory expansions and production ramps, including space, staffing, and training.
* Improve productivity through standard work, waste reduction, daily performance management, process automation, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) system improvements, in partnership with IT, Manufacturing Engineering, and Continuous Improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in manufacturing inventory, warehousing, and logistics, including 5+ years leading supervisors and teams across multiple sites and shifts.
* Demonstrated success scaling warehouse operations in a high-growth manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of inventory controls, ERP transactions, cycle counting, kanban, supermarkets, production replenishment, and order kitting.
* Experience managing shipping operations, transportation providers, and freight costs.
* Experience supporting repetitive manufacturing production.
* Demonstrated ability to improve inventory accuracy, establish consistent operating practices, and develop effective supervisors and team leaders.
* Ability to analyze operational and financial data, resolve problems, and communicate priorities and issues across functions.
* Experience implementing Lean or continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, operations, engineering, or a related field
* Relevant supply chain, logistics, or Lean certification.
* Experience with Infor SyteLine, barcode scanning, and warehouse management systems.
* Experience in electrical equipment, industrial products, or similarly complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting configure-to-order or engineer-to-order production.

**Location:** Longmont, CO

**Base Compensation:** $135,000 - $165,000 is the projected range of annual base salary for this role depending on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience.

**Bonus:** This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.

**Closing Date:** December 1st. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs.

**Onsite Perks**

* Free gym with 24/7 access
* Free Electric Vehicle charging
* Breakfast and Lunch Café
* After hours Grab & Go snacks
* Basketball court
* Walking paths

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan with immediate vesting
* Employee referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Professional development

At SENS, our culture is rooted in a set of core values that reflect who we are and how we work. In a recent 2025 poll, our employees identified the values that best define us: *“Innovative”, “Respectful”, “Inviting”, “Flexible”, “Collaborative”, and “Growth Driven”.* Our team describes us as a dynamic, forward-thinking company where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, fully dedicated to fostering inclusion and diversity. We welcome all applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We hope you're interested in making a difference with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every qualification listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager Quality Sterility Assurance
new_roles.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

**Job Description**

**Title: Senior Manager Quality Sterility Assurance**
-----------------------------------------------------

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Division/Site Specific Information**

Role reports to the Ridgefield, NJ site and reports to the Drug Product Division within the Pharma Services Group.

 

**Discover Impactful Work:** 
As a Senior Manager of Quality at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide strategic quality initiatives and support a culture of continuous improvement across our organization. You'll oversee quality management systems, ensure regulatory compliance, and enhance customer experience through excellent quality standards. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll develop and implement quality strategies that support our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

**A Day in the Life:**
----------------------

* In this role, you'll manage quality assurance and quality control teams while building strong partnerships with operations, R&D, commercial teams, and customers.
* You'll guide process improvements through Practical Process Improvement (PPI) methodologies and risk-based approaches.
* Your leadership will be essential in maintaining inspection readiness, managing customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements.
* As a member of the Quality Leadership Team, you'll support quality initiatives that deliver consistent product excellence while meeting business objectives.
* You'll develop quality professionals, lead investigations, and implement data-driven solutions that enhance our quality systems and customer satisfaction.

**Keys to Success:**

**Education/Experience**
------------------------

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical, medical device, or regulated life sciences industry required.
* Preferred Fields of Study: Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or related technical field
* Professional certifications desired (ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, etc.)
* 5+ years of quality management/leadership experience
* Experience hosting regulatory inspections and customer audits
* Experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives
* Experience with quality tools including FMEA, Risk Analysis, and Root Cause Analysis

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

 

* Expert knowledge of global quality standards (ISO 13485, ISO 9001, FDA 21 CFR 820, EU MDR/IVDR)
* Strong understanding of quality management systems and GMP requirements
* Demonstrated experience leading quality investigations, CAPA, and change control processes
* Excellent project management and cross-functional leadership abilities
* Strong data analysis and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to build collaborative relationships at all levels
* Proficiency with quality management software systems

**Benefits**

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in New Jersey is $143,200.00–$214,900.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Strategy & Operations, Point of Care, Remote
new_roles.description:
Working in the Office of the Chief Medical Officer and reporting to the VP of Point of Care & Risk Stratification, the Senior Director of Strategy & Operations, Point of Care, will lead day-to-day operations, partnerships, go-to-market efforts, and wraparound support services to maximize the impact of Aledade’s value-based care insights to our partner practices.

The team is looking for a high-output generalist with a strong business analyst toolkit, looking to rapidly take ownership of complex content with high visibility, working across multiple stakeholders. Candidates that thrive managing multiple deadlines on tight timelines and learning content quickly are best positioned to succeed; successful team members in the same function primarily have backgrounds in consulting and generalist healthcare strategy & operations roles.

To start, the role will focus on 1) scaling the deployment of our point of care tools and 2) broadening and deepening the insights available in our point of care tools, to maximize the impact of Aledade’s insights on our patients’ health outcomes and partner practices’ success in their value-based care contracts.

At the end of their first year, a successful leader in the role will own end-to-end accountability for 1) proactive identification, development, and execution of Point of Care deployment improvement opportunities, including field, practice, and clinician education, deployment automation and monitoring, and go to market approach and materials, 2) strategic relationship building and partnership with Aledade’s payer partners to advance point of care tool adoption and impact, 3) goal setting, metric identification and development, and impact evaluation for our point of care tools, 4) identification, evaluation, contracting, and cross-functional execution of net new vendor and external partnerships that support insight delivery and impact.

Additionally, this role will 1) provide direction and expert guidance to junior team members owning individual initiatives, including incentive and adoption programs, educational efforts, hotspotting, monitoring, and alerting development, practice and user-level prioritization and triage, and 2) coordinate with cross-functional product, analytics, technology, performance, care programs, and other senior leaders across Aledade to advance point of care tool adoption and impact.

The role is expected to start as a senior individual contributor, but is expected to grow into a people manager in the near term.

### **Primary Duties:**

In collaboration with cross-functional product, analytics, technology, performance, care programs, and other senior leaders across Aledade:

* Own single-threaded accountability for proactive identification, development, and execution of Point of Care deployment improvement opportunities, including field, practice, and clinician education, deployment automation and monitoring, and go to market approach and materials

* Lead strategic relationship building and partnership with Aledade’s payer partners to advance point of care tool adoption and impact

* Drive goal setting, metric identification and development, and impact evaluation for our point of care tools

* In support of maximizing insight delivery and impact, lead the evaluation, contracting, and cross-functional execution of net new vendor and external partnerships

* Direct and support other Transformation team members’ ideation and execution of strategic initiatives related to point of care deployment and impact

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in Economics, Business, Healthcare, or a related field
* 12+ years of progressive professional experience, or 7+ years progressive professional experience with a Master’s Degree, strongly preferred
* 6+ years of experience in healthcare
* 2+ years of experience in value-based care

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced exploration of emerging AI tools, with additional preference given to individuals that have demonstrated ability building, scaling, and/or teaching AI tooling to broader teams
* Expert Excel skills required, including the ability to work with large, complex, & often incomplete data sets; conduct one-off complex analyses quickly; and utilize Index / Match, XLOOKUP, FILTER, and other advanced formulas
* Advanced PPT skills required, including storyboarding skills, ability to translate complex analyses and concepts into engaging slides, and ability to draft executive-level materials with limited direction
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, as well as the ability to build strong relationships and work with individuals at all levels of the organization, tailoring communication style as appropriate based on audience
* Excellent project management skills, including proven track record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in health care operations settings
* Strong strategic planning and analytical skills
* Strong “business analyst” toolkit, including abilities to independently prioritize, solve problems via hypothesis-driven analytical methods, manage across multiple responsibilities and projects, execute with attention to detail, and overcome ambiguity
* Poise, confidence, and maturity interacting with key stakeholders, including senior leaders
* Commitment to confidentiality and discretion in appropriately handling sensitive information is required

### **Physical Requirements:**

Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

**Who We Are:**

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

**What Does This Mean for You?**

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:

Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles

Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners

Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)

Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays

12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents

Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service

Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program

401(k) with up to 4% match

Stock options

And much more!

*At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.*

 

We may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help organize and evaluate application materials. These tools support our recruiters and hiring managers by helping manage large applicant pools. Human judgment plays an essential role in our hiring process, including in the oversight and use of any automated tools. If you would like more information about our screening and hiring process, please contact us. Our Commitment to Authenticity. We use Endorsed, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Aledade PBC using Lever, a cloud services provider located in the United States. Lever is engaged by Aledade PBC to help manage its recruitment and hiring processes. For more information about how your personal data will be processed by Aledade PBC and any rights you may have, please review Aledade PBC’s Candidate Privacy Notice. By applying for this job, you agree to Aledade's Applicant Privacy Policy available at https://www.aledade.com/privacy-policy-applicants If you have any questions about our privacy practices, please contact privacy@aledade.com.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Description**

**Job Overview:**

The Director of Operations provides leadership and oversight for vertical initiatives that enhance operational performance, strengthen community management services, and ensure alignment with evolving legislative and industry requirements. This role serves as the primary expert for change‑management, acting as the central point of accountability for new initiatives, implementation timelines, communication strategies, and reporting outcomes.

Working in close partnership with market leaders and cross‑functional departments, the Director evaluates, tests, and deploys operational improvements that drive efficiency and elevate service delivery. The role also collaborates extensively with Operations leadership across Master Planned Vertical to share best practices, execute strategic initiatives, and support scalable, high‑impact operational enhancements. The Director operates under the direction of the President, Master Planned Communities.

**Your Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Leadership & Change Management**

* Provide market oversight for process improvement initiatives, including operational enhancements, legislative implementation, regional, and national program cascades.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and organizational gatekeeper for all change‑management activities, ensuring disciplined execution and alignment with regional and enterprise priorities.
* Own accountability for initiative timelines, implementation plans, communication strategies, and reporting deliverables, including ongoing user acceptance and adoption.

**Operational Excellence & Efficiency**

* Lead the assessment, vetting, testing, and rollout of operational improvements in partnership with market leaders and internal stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to refine or redesign existing programs, procedures, and workflows to enhance efficiency and service quality.
* Drive continuous improvement across core community management operations through data‑driven analysis and cross‑functional collaboration.
* Leads compliance within the market with retention programs; NPS, Watchlist, Board Orientation.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with internal departments—including Training, HR, Accounting, Legal, region operations, and Technology—to ensure seamless implementation of operational changes.
* Act as a senior liaison between community management and support departments, ensuring alignment, transparency, and effective communication.
* Facilitate knowledge‑sharing and best‑practice adoption across Hi-rise North markets.

**Regional & Enterprise Engagement**

* Collaborate with Operations leaders on region and national initiatives and create scalable efficiencies.
* Support enterprise‑level initiatives and programs by participating in committees, governance groups, and project teams as requested, i.e. NPS.
* Ensure regional alignment with corporate standards, programs, and strategic priorities. Collaborates with regional operations and Directions (peers) on best practices, process improvement, and standardization across the region, reducing redundancy.

**Reporting & Communication**

* Develop and deliver clear, comprehensive reports on initiative progress, operational integration, and service‑level performance.
* Communicate complex operational changes in a clear, objective, and strategic manner to leadership and cross‑functional partners.
* Maintain a forward‑looking understanding of industry trends, legislative developments, and emerging best practices.
* Consistently uphold the values of the organization and provide the highest level of customer service to internal clients.
* Consistent, motivating, thoughtful leadership style to lead others.
* Must be able to attend and actively participate in night meetings as required.
* Occasional attendance at board meetings.
* Perform any range of special projects, tasks and other related duties as assigned.
* Champion the use of internal and external programs and software to support all roles.
* Other duties may be required.

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* Excellent customer service and relationship-building background/skills (internal and external).
* Demonstrated success leading cross‑functional initiatives and driving organizational change.
* Proven ability to influence without direct authority and collaborate across multiple markets.
* Ability to effectively strategize with the overall vision of the organization in mind.
* Ability to work under tight deadlines and consistently meet deadlines.
* Demonstrates effective communication skills consisting of oral, written, and listening.

* Demonstrates problem-solving and solving abilities.
* Ability to draft correspondence and respond to inquiries effectively and independently.
* Ability to read and understand financial statements and budgets.
* Must be proficient with computer programs needed for specific positions including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
* Demonstrates organizational skills and time management abilities while working in a fast-paced, multitasking environment.
* Must work effectively with co-workers, customers, and others by sharing ideas in a constructive and positive manner; listening to and objectively considering ideas and suggestions from others; keeping commitments; keeping others informed of work progress, timetables, and issues; addressing problems and issues constructively to find mutually acceptable and practical business solutions; addressing others by name, title, or other respectful identifiers, and; respecting the diversity of our workforce in actions, words, and deeds.

**Physical Requirements:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This position works under usual office conditions. The employee is required to work at a personal computer as well as be on the phone for extended periods of time. Must be able to stand, sit and walk. The incumbent must be able to work extended and flexible hours and weekends as needed. Physical demands include ability to lift up to 10 lbs.

**What We Offer:**

As a full-time associate, you will be eligible for full comprehensive benefits to include your choice of multiple medical plans, dental, and Vision. In addition, you will be eligible for time off benefits, paid holidays, and a 401k with company match. Occasional travel may be required to attend training and other company functions.

**Compensation:** $90,000-$110,000 annually; paid bi-weekly

**Schedule:** Monday-Friday (9:00AM-5:00PM)

**Disclaimer****:**

The above information in this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. This is not an all-inclusive job description; therefore, management has the right to assign or reassign schedules, duties, and responsibilities to this job at any time.

 
 
**Automated Employment Decision Tool (AEDT) Usage:** We may utilize an Automated Employment Decision Tool (AEDT) in connection with the assessment or evaluation of candidates. The AEDT is designed to assist in objectively evaluating candidate qualifications based on specific job-related characteristics. 
 
**Job Qualifications and Characteristics Assessed:** The AEDT evaluates candidates based on job qualifications and characteristics pertinent to the role, including skills, experience, and competencies relevant to the position requirements. These qualifications are determined by the unique needs of each role within our company. 
 
**Alternative Selection Process or Reasonable Accommodations:** Candidates who require an alternative selection process or a “reasonable accommodation,” as defined under applicable disability laws, may make a request through our designated contact channel national\_recruiting@fsresidential.com. 
 
**Requesting Information About the AEDT - NYC Local Law 144:** Candidates who reside in New York City and are subject to NYC Local Law 144 may request information about the AEDT, including details on the type of data collected, the sources of such data, and our data retention policies. To submit a request, please contact us at national\_recruiting@fsresidential.com; we will respond in accordance with Local Law 144, within 30 days.
