new_roles.title: Director of Supplier Quality - Operations & Compliance
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Director, Supplier Quality – Operations & Compliance reports to the AVP, Supplier Quality and is responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing the Supplier Quality Assurance program across Agilent businesses and sites. This role is focused on improving product quality, process quality, supplier performance, and delivery throughout the supply base.

The Director will have direct responsibility for supplier quality processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), tools, dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and the Approved Supplier List (ASL).

A key priority for this role is developing and implementing a Supplier Quality Operations strategy that centralizes and standardizes processes while ensuring consistent compliance of all processes used in the Supplier Quality organization, including Agilent sites, SQ business leads, SQ category leads, and suppliers.

The successful candidate will be a proactive, self-directed leader who can build strong partnerships across Agilent and the external supply base while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

* Own, improve, and standardize supplier quality processes, including supplier Audits, Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), Supplier Change Management, Supplier Review Boards (SRBs), and Approved Supplier List (ASL) processes.
* Partner closely with Procurement, business and site leadership, Category teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure effective and consistent execution of supplier quality processes.
* Develop, improve, and continuously monitor a standardized KPI and metrics program, including executive-level dashboards that provide meaningful, actionable visibility into supplier performance and overall supply chain health.
* Present and support Supplier Quality metrics and performance discussions during Quality Management Review (QMR) and Supplier Review Board (SRB) meetings.
* Manage the quality aspects of the Approved Supplier List in partnership with Procurement.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement across the Supplier Quality function, establish project ownership, monitor progress, and ensure measurable results at project completion.
* Develop and manage the Supplier Quality outsourcing strategy, including evaluating outsourcing opportunities for audits, root cause analysis (RCA), and other Supplier Quality activities.
* Strengthen the culture of quality and compliance by identifying and implementing continuous improvement opportunities across Supplier Quality processes.
* Partner with Procurement to establish a consistent **"One-Voice Agilent"** approach when communicating with the supply base.
* Evaluate and implement a supplier portal in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Engage key supplier management teams through structured business reviews to monitor performance metrics, identify trends, address risks, and implement programs that deliver measurable performance improvements.
* Lead, manage, coach, and develop a high-performing and diverse team of Supplier Quality professionals.
* Own and manage the budget for the Supplier Quality Operations function.
* Strengthen supplier and organizational quality culture through coaching, technical engagement, and collaborative problem-solving.

**Qualifications**
------------------

 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related discipline preferred.

**Experience**
--------------

 

* 5+ years of direct or related experience in Supplier Quality.
* 3+ years of experience leading and managing teams.
* Experience owning or managing a Quality Management System (QMS), particularly Supplier Quality processes associated with **ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485**.
* Significant experience with sourcing, supplier management, and quality execution within highly regulated or demanding industries such as medical devices, automotive, aerospace and defense, or similarly complex markets.
* Demonstrated experience working effectively within a matrixed organization.

**Essential Skills & Competencies**
-----------------------------------

 

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across organizational levels, functions, cultures, and external organizations.
* Proactive, self-directed leadership style with the ability to identify challenges, develop solutions, and drive implementation.
* Strong commitment to quality, compliance, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective systems and establish trust with suppliers, internal customers, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Proven ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members while fostering collaboration and teamwork.
* Ability to navigate and de-escalate challenging or high-pressure situations calmly and effectively.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to translate supplier and quality data into actionable insights for senior leadership.
* Ability to travel occasionally.

**Additional Details**

This job has a full time weekly schedule. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least November 19, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $160,240.00 - $300,450.00/yr USD in the US, or $134,218.00 - $209,715.00/yr CAD in Canada, plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, pregnancy, race, religion or religious creed, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, local law, ordinance, or regulation and will not be discriminated against on these bases. new_roles.title: Strategic Operations Director
new_roles.description:
**Location:** New York, NY 
**Compensation:** $170,000 - $190,000 base salary + annual bonus 
**Travel:** 25%

In 2017, Shields established the Strategic Operations team to partner directly with the Executive Leadership Team in executing the company's highest-priority initiatives. These efforts span corporate strategy, operational transformation, performance improvement, growth execution, business development, and new business innovation. Team members gain exposure to all aspects of the organization, combining executive-level engagement with hands-on responsibility for translating strategy into measurable results. The team has served as a pathway to leadership, with alumni advancing into senior roles across Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership. This role offers the opportunity to build on that legacy while helping shape Shields' next phase of growth and innovation.

The **Director of Strategic Operations** serves as a senior leader responsible for driving strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and growth across Shields' portfolio of health system specialty pharmacy partnerships. This role is ideal for individuals with experience as a **Healthcare Consulting Engagement Manager, Healthcare Strategy Leader, Strategic Operations Leader, Transformation Leader, Management Consultant, or operations executive within a private equity-backed healthcare services organization** seeking an opportunity to influence enterprise-level decision-making and organizational performance.

Leading a team of high-performing professionals, the Director will oversee complex cross-functional initiatives, deliver executive-level analyses and recommendations, and partner directly with senior leaders to drive exceptional clinical, operational, and financial outcomes. Functioning as an internal strategy and operations leader, this individual will identify growth opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and translate strategic priorities into measurable results across the organization.

This role is particularly well suited for professionals coming from **healthcare consulting, management consulting, healthcare strategy, portfolio operations, business transformation, performance improvement, or private equity-backed healthcare organizations** who are looking for the opportunity to move beyond recommendations and directly own execution. Success requires strong strategic thinking, structured problem solving, financial and operational acumen, executive presence, and the ability to influence stakeholders across a fast-paced, high-growth healthcare environment.

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and resourceful leader who thrives in entrepreneurial settings, excels at managing ambiguity, and has a demonstrated track record of leading strategic initiatives that drive growth, value creation, operational excellence, and performance improvement.

**Job Duties**

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

* Serve as a key leader within the Strategic Operations team, driving growth, strategic execution, and organizational performance through both direct leadership and individual contributions.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of high-performing professionals responsible for supporting critical business initiatives across the organization.
* Oversee the planning, execution, and monitoring of strategic and operational initiatives aligned with Shields' highest-priority objectives.
* Synthesize complex operational, financial, and market insights into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development.

### **Strategy, Operations & Performance Improvement**

* Partner directly with Senior Vice Presidents and Regional Vice Presidents of Operations to drive strong financial, operational, and clinical outcomes across Shields' health system partnerships.
* Collaborate with operational leadership to identify, prioritize, and execute strategic objectives while ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Lead day-to-day strategy and operational execution for a portfolio of health system partnerships.
* Develop business cases, financial models, forecasts, and performance analyses to support executive decision-making.
* Drive high-impact initiatives focused on operational excellence, growth strategy, performance improvement, transformation, and value creation.
* Conduct analyses to identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, process improvement, and partnership expansion.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior operational leaders, providing strategic guidance and analytical support.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration across Operations, Finance, Business Development, Clinical, Technology, Human Resources, and Executive Leadership teams.

### **Partnership & Stakeholder Management**

* Own and cultivate relationships with senior health system executives and key external stakeholders.
* Act as a strategic liaison between Shields leadership and health system partners to ensure alignment on priorities and objectives.
* Support executive presentations, partnership reviews, business planning sessions, and strategic steering committees.
* Translate complex analyses into compelling executive-level presentations and recommendations.

### **Growth & Innovation**

* Identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities, ancillary services, operational enhancements, and growth initiatives that increase partnership value.
* Support strategic planning, business development, market expansion, and innovation efforts across the organization.
* Evaluate market trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging healthcare opportunities to inform strategic decision-making.

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's degree required; MBA, MHA, MPH, or other advanced degree strongly preferred.
* 8+ years of professional experience with a demonstrated track record of strategic and operational leadership within healthcare.
* Experience in one or more of the following environments strongly preferred:
 + **Healthcare Consulting Firms** (Engagement Manager, Manager, Project Leader, Senior Manager, Principal, or equivalent roles)
 + **Private Equity-Backed Healthcare Services Organizations**
 + **Corporate Strategy, Strategic Operations, Transformation, Portfolio Operations, or Performance Improvement Functions**
 + **Health Systems, Specialty Pharmacy, Provider Services, Population Health, Revenue Cycle, or Healthcare Services Organizations**
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy development through implementation and performance measurement.
* Proven ability to drive operational excellence, business transformation, growth strategy, and performance improvement initiatives in complex healthcare environments.
* Experience developing and presenting strategic recommendations, performance updates, and business insights to executive leadership teams and Board-level audiences.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, business case development, forecasting, and executive-level presentations.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to solve complex business problems using data-driven approaches.
* Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading through influence in highly matrixed organizations.
* Proven self-starter with the ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and deliver results in fast-paced environments.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and workstreams simultaneously.
* Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Healthcare industry experience strongly preferred.
* Willingness to travel approximately 25% to engage with health system executives, operational leaders, pharmacists, clinicians, and partnership stakeholders.

Why Join Shields?

* Partner directly with Executive Leadership on the company's most important strategic priorities.
* Lead high-impact initiatives that drive growth, operational excellence, and transformative outcomes across a national network of health system partnerships.
* Gain broad exposure to corporate strategy, healthcare operations, business development, and executive decision-making.
* Join a proven leadership pipeline that has developed future leaders across Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership.
* Help shape the future of healthcare through innovative specialty pharmacy solutions that improve patient outcomes and strengthen health system partnerships.

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
The Director, Operational Excellence, is a hands-on practitioner who supports ESCO sites in deploying the **ESCO Operating System (EOS)**. The person in this role travels to sites to facilitate Kaizen events, take part in key EOS activities, and coach site leaders and teams to strengthen EOS adoption, practice, and results.

Site Presidents and site EOS Managers own and lead EOS deployment at their sites. This role supports them as an experienced practitioner and member of a small central EOS team. The EOS Program Lead owns program strategy and the development of EOS elements, and a peer role owns data, tools, KPIs, and monthly business reviews. This role helps sites put EOS standards into practice on the floor and brings field learning back to improve those standards.

This is a director-level individual contributor role with no direct reports. It works through influence with site leaders and teams. The initial focus is the Aerospace & Defense group, with expansion to other ESCO divisions as EOS deployment grows.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Site Deployment Support***

* Support site Presidents and EOS Managers in executing their annual EOS deployment plans toward EOS maturity certifications.
* Participate in key EOS activities during site visits, such as MDI, Kaizen events, and Gemba Walks, and provide sites with direct feedback to enhance adoption and practice.
* Help sites put EOS elements into practice, including MDI, Gemba Walks, KPI management, action management, P&R, structured problem solving, and leader standard work.
* Provide sites with continued support to improve EOS adoption, sustainment, and results.

***Kaizen and Improvement Events***

* Plan and facilitate Kaizen events with site teams: scoping and chartering with site leadership, pre-event data collection, team training, current state analysis, implementation on the floor, report-out, and 30/60/90-day follow-up.
* Help sites build and manage their CI pipeline so events are selected based on business priorities, KPI gaps, and financial impact.
* Develop site Kaizen leaders and facilitators so sites can run events on their own and meet their annual Kaizen plan.
* Document event results and savings, and partner with site finance to validate benefits.

***Coaching and Capability Building***

* Deliver EOS training on site, from leadership sessions to hands-on floor training for supervisors and team members.
* Coach site leaders, supervisors, and EOS Managers on daily management, visual management, standard work, and problem solving.
* Support site EOS Managers in developing EOS champions and practitioners at their sites.

***Assessment, Tracking, and Feedback***

* Support EOS maturity assessments and certification readiness reviews, including site tours, interviews, and evidence review.
* Monitor deployment progress, action closure, and sustainment at supported sites, and report status to the EOS Program Lead.
* Help site leaders remove barriers, and raise issues to the EOS Program Lead when deployment is at risk.
* Bring field feedback into the EOS program: what works, what does not, and where process guides, tools, and training need to change.
* Share good practices across sites and connect site teams with each other.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Supply Chain, or related field required.
* 8+ years of experience in operational excellence, continuous improvement, Lean, or manufacturing operations, including at least 5 years in a hands-on deployment or practitioner role.
* Has personally facilitated 10 - 20 or more Kaizen events with documented results.
* Hands-on experience practicing and coaching tiered daily management (MDI or similar), Gemba Walks, visual management, standard work, and structured problem solving (A3, PDCA, root cause analysis).
* Experience in a company with a structured operating or business system strongly preferred. Must be a U.S. Person and able to provide appropriate documentation
* Experience supporting deployment across multiple sites preferred.
* Plant or operations leadership experience preferred. Credibility with site leaders and on the floor is essential.
* Aerospace, defense, industrial, or complex high-mix manufacturing experience preferred.
* Lean, Kaizen, or Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Must be a U.S. Person with a valid US passport with the ability to travel internationally.

**Required Capabilities**

* Practitioner first: comfortable on the shop floor and leading teams through hands-on change.
* Strong event facilitation, with the ability to lead mixed teams from operators to executives.
* Direct, constructive coaching of leaders at all levels, including senior leaders.
* Business acumen: connects improvement work to KPIs, EBIT, and customer commitments.
* Ability to adapt to sites at different maturity levels without lowering the standard.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.
* Self-directed and organized; manages a multi-site schedule with limited supervision.
* High accountability for follow-through and sustainment.

**Travel**

Expected travel of approximately **60% to 80%**, primarily domestic, with some international travel to sites in Mexico and the UK. A typical site visit runs 3 to 5 days, such as a Kaizen event week or a site support visit covering MDI, Gemba Walks, and other EOS activities. Candidates should be based near a major airport.

**Compensation Information** 
Base Salary Range: $190,000 - $220,000 USD (Annually)

**Actual base salary offered to the hired applicant will be determined based on their work location, level, qualifications, job related skills, as well as relevant education or training experience.**

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Head of Operations - Wealth Management
new_roles.description:
*South Key is conducting a confidential search for a Head of Operations for one of its clients.*

**Head of Operations, Wealth Management Service Delivery** 
Remote (U.S.; Eastern or Central time zone preferred) · Full-time · Reports to the COO 
Starting base salary $150,000 plus bonus

**About the company**

We are a growing operations partner to registered investment advisors. Our team works as an extension of our clients' staff, handling financial planning support, investment operations, new business processing and client service so advisors can focus on their clients and their growth.

**The role**

The Head of Operations is a leadership role, accountable for service delivery, quality, capacity and team performance across all of our client firms. You will lead a remote team of 20+ across client service, investment operations and financial planning, and build the team-lead layer beneath you.

You will stay close to daily operations, but you will lead through your team leads and managers rather than doing the work yourself. This is not a working-supervisor role. Over the next year, you will build an operation that can support significant client growth.

**What you'll do**

Service delivery and quality 
- Own timely, accurate delivery across all operations service lines. 
- Set service standards, quality controls and escalation procedures. 
- Track turnaround times, SLA commitments, errors, NIGOs, rework and client feedback, and fix the root causes of recurring problems. 
- Serve as the senior escalation point for significant delivery issues.

Team leadership 
- Lead, coach and develop team leads and staff with clear responsibilities and performance expectations. 
- Run consistent training, performance reviews and accountability. 
- Partner with recruiting to define staffing needs, interview candidates and onboard new hires. 
- Build career paths, cross-training and backup coverage that support retention.

Capacity and delivery economics 
- Keep a forward-looking 60–90 day view of workload, staffing, skills and available capacity. 
- Measure capacity and put the right staffing structure in place, including team-lead and manager roles, as the business grows. 
- Recommend hiring and resource allocation based on demand, service requirements and financial impact. 
- Balance productivity with quality and sustainable workloads. 
- Make sure new client start dates line up with operational readiness.

Process improvement and onboarding 
- Build, standardize and document core workflows while allowing for differences between client firms. 
- Improve workflows to reduce manual work, errors and unnecessary handoffs, partnering with the technology team on automation and system changes. 
- Own operational readiness for new client engagements: staffing, training, workflows and handoffs.

Reporting 
- Maintain a weekly operations scorecard covering quality, service levels, capacity, staffing and delivery risks. 
- Turn performance data into clear actions, owners and deadlines, and own the department's quarterly priorities.

**What you'll bring**

* 3–5 years of direct people-management experience, including hiring, coaching, performance management and staffing decisions. Project leadership alone is not enough.
* Experience overseeing multiple operations functions, such as client service, new business and account opening, money movement, investment operations and financial planning support.
* Experience developing team leads or managers who run their own teams.
* A track record of building and scaling an operation, not only maintaining one: building processes, improving workflows, measuring capacity and putting the right staffing structure in place as the organization grew, with measurable improvements in turnaround time, accuracy, productivity or service levels.
* Experience leading operations or advisor services in wealth management at an RIA. Custodian candidates are welcome if they have led advisor-facing service operations and understand how independent RIAs operate across client service, new business and investment operations.
* Hands-on knowledge of advisory firm workflows: account opening, transfers, custodian requirements, client service and operational accuracy.
* RIA candidates: experience at a firm with more than $500M AUM. $1B+ is preferred.
* Experience leading remote teams.
* Direct, collaborative communication and confidence handling difficult performance conversations.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Salesforce, Redtail and common custodian platforms.
* Workflow automation or process-improvement experience.
* Experience with a structured operating or accountability framework (for example EOS).

**Your first 90 days**

* Get to know the team and each client's delivery requirements.
* Assess immediate service, staffing and coverage risks.
* Clarify responsibilities and escalation paths across operations.
* Set baseline metrics and weekly reporting.
* Build a 60–90 day capacity forecast and a prioritized improvement plan.

**How to apply**

This search is confidential and is being handled by South Key. Company details will be shared with qualified candidates after an initial conversation.

Pay: $150,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)

new_roles.title: Operational Excellence Director
new_roles.description:
At E Tech Group, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward-thinking experts. We're one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 30 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals & Mining, Warehousing & Distribution, and CPG/Food & Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site.

We're adding to our team! We are seeking an **Operational Excellence****Director** to lead the optimization of workflows and play a key role in the continuous improvement across all projects and operations. This role ensures alignment with industry best practices, including CSIA Best Practices, while driving consistent, high-quality delivery in automation and integration projects.

**You will:**

* Ensure workflows meet E Tech Group and Business Unit quality policies, procedures, CSIA Best Practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct internal audits to evaluate adherence to standards, practical efficiency of associated tools, assess root-cause failure modes, and support corrective and preventive actions.
* Business Unit representative for E Tech's Continuous Improvement Committee, providing practical suggestions and solutions, communicating with Business Unit leadership.
* Analyze project execution workflows to identify and remove bottlenecks, directly improving project lead times and margin predictability.
* Identify and champion the use of digital tools and AI to automate repetitive administrative tasks, reducing 'process friction' for engineering teams.
* Represent the Business Unit for Customer and third party audits, including audit preparation, participation, response coordination, and follow up.
* Foster quality, consistency, and ongoing improvement across cross-functional teams.
* Support Corporate Continuous Improvement initiatives including development and review of policies and procedures.
* Lead Business Unit continuous improvement activities.
* Provide necessary supplemental training and guidance to the Business Unit on quality standards, procedures, and expectations.
* Provide support to improve the quality and effectiveness of the Learning Management System (LMS)
* Encourage collaboration, shared learning, and knowledge transfer across teams throughout the Company
* Collaborate with Sales, Application Engineering, and the Project Management Organization to support project risk assessments, and quality planning.
* Attend project reviews, as needed, and provide guidance to project teams for compliance with Project Management Life Cycle (PMLC) and System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and other procedures during project execution.
* Interface with clients and third parties on quality related topics, including audits, vendor qualification, and compliance inquiries.
* Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates.

 

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical or Systems), or related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Over seven years of experience in process improvement and engineering performance within technical, project-driven settings. Proven track record in supporting process optimization, waste reduction, quality assurance, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives in engineering or project environments.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to influence technical teams and stakeholders
* Experience working in automation, life sciences or other regulated industries, prefer knowledge of ISO 9001, GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Computer System Assurance (CSA).
* Experience supporting automation and control systems (PLC, DCS, SCADA, HMI).
* A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork.

 

**Benefits & Perks:**

* 401k + match + prompt enrollment. E Tech Group employees are 100% vested upon entry.
* Prompt enrollment into Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
* Generous paid time off that includes paid vacation, paid holidays, paid family leave and sick time off.
* Learning and growth are key parts of the E Tech culture. We provide you with training and continuing education from day one, so you can advance your career. As an E Tech associate, you can unlock your greatest potential through challenges and opportunities.

Salary Range: $150,000-$170,000

*E Tech Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law. E Tech Group will provide reasonable* *accommodations* *to qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs. E Tech Group is an Affirmative Action Employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.*

new_roles.title: Front of House Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Front of House Director of Operations**
=========================================

**Chick-fil-A | Eldorado & Ridge**

* Full-time
* Starting from $24.00 per hour
* 6201 Eldorado Parkway, McKinney, TX, US, 75070

Description

Front of House is your business and you are expected to own it. Front of House rises and falls on you. You will be measured based on the performance of your business and evaluated on how effective and efficient your business is being run. Effective ownership of this role includes identifying critical systems that need to be created or refined in the kitchen to achieve our Winning Hearts Every Day strategy metrics. The Director understands how to leverage strategic partnerships with high performing Directors, Managers, or Team Leads that are passionate and engaged in the business to ultimately achieve excellent business results. The Director is responsible for following through with all Leadership pertaining to implementation, accountability, and utilization of the created systems and restaurant processes.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Talent**

* Proactively monitoring & tracking FOH staffing par levels
* Partnering with HR Administrator to ensure FOH workforce numbers are sufficient for operational excellence across all dayparts.
* Partnering with HR Administrator within the hiring process
* Screening & interviewing Team Member applicants based on HR interview guide
* Screening & interviewing FOH Leadership applicants based on HR leadership interview guide
* Proactively documenting disciplinary issues & coaching conversations with FOH Managers appropriately to ultimately support HR Director.

**Leadership Development**

Conduct reoccurring monthly one-on-one coaching sessions with all FOH Managers ensuring:

* Each FOH Manager has a development plan in place and understands what is needed to achieve their next step.
* Each FOH Manager is adhering to necessary operational hard skills & processes.
* Follow up monthly on development goals.
* Utilize the one-on-one time to identify opportunity areas, and areas of success.
* Set action plans for Leadership and set follow up meetings.

Oversee Leadership Development for all HOH employees, working closely with the Management team to ensure mid-level leaders have development plans.

Partner with HR Administrator to conduct quarterly audits for all FOH Leadership Team roles and responsibilities.

Participate in weekly Manager meetings

**System Development**

Forecasting & Scheduling

* Proactively monitoring local ISD calendars to ensure restaurant dayparts are adequately staffed when school is out thus minimizing business disruption.
* Partnering with FOH Director to review and adjust forecasted sales projections ensuring 97% or higher efficiency between system forecast sales and adjusted forecast sales.
* Adjust schedule to reflect shift feedback notes from FOH Managers and Team Leaders.
* Responding to FOH employee requests off in a timely manner
* Holding FOH Managers/Coordinators/Team Leads/Captains/Employees & Seasonal Employees accountable to weekly shift minimums
* Reviewing previous week’s schedule productivity and labor totals to identify wins and areas of opportunities.

FOH Visuals & Dashboards

* Establishing a system for ensuring all FOH posted visuals and digital systems for tracking Winning Hearts Every Day metrics are always relevant, up to date, and meet visual identity standards.
* Create or uphold organization of each station by ensuring that a schematic is in use for each section.
* Establishing a system for ensuring each FOH position has a positional expectation card clearly posted and up to date meeting visual identity standards.

Food Safety & Food Cost

* Performing weekly audit of Daily Safe Critical manager assessments
* Maintaining a score of 1 on Food Safety Report every quarter
* Utilizing timers, temperature checks and lean iPads for production
* Ensuring all items are labeled and stored with proper rotation
* Establish and communicate Mock Food Safety Audit Schedule
* Execute lean ordering, thawing, prep, and cooking

FOH/Facilities/Equipment/Storage Cleanliness & Organization

* Develop a schedule for detail cleaning for each piece of equipment
* Develop a schedule for detail cleaning of each “zone” or restaurant area
* Hold all FOH Managers/Coordinators/Team Leads accountable to systems across all dayparts to cleanliness & organization standards

Inventory & Product Accountability

* Ensuring FOH Managers are conducting weekly inventory spot checks.
* Ensuring FOH Managers systematically understand & participate in Month End Inventory counting process.
* Oversee Supply Chain Team Members to ensure proper inventory levels are maintained.

**Gap Analysis & Strategic Planning**

* Weekly audit & gap analysis of specific Analytics Hub reporting relative my HOH business.
* Weekly audit & gap analysis of Customer Experience Monitor metrics compared to monthly & quarterly business goals
* Weekly audit of Customer Experience Monitor comments to identify gaps in operational systems or leadership
* Weekly FOH overall reporting to Director Team & Operator on Director following EOS principles
* Weekly auditing of restaurant FOH smallwares and partnering with Administrative/Financial Director concerning smallwares budgeting and expenditures.
* Conducting monthly & quarterly Director action planning and evaluating your plan to ensure alignment with our shared organizational goals.
* Participating in Quarterly Team Wide Meetings to provide insight surrounding FOH Systems & People performance.
* Participating in Director Team Annual Strategic Planning

new_roles.title: Director of Facilities and Operations
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

The Director of Facilities & Operations serves as a key member of the leadership team and is responsible for the stewardship, maintenance, safety, and operational excellence of the retreat center’s older buildings, grounds, infrastructure, and support services. Guided by Franciscan values of simplicity, compassion, peace, and reverence for creation, this role ensures that the physical environment reflects a spirit of hospitality, beauty, and care for all who visit.

The Director oversees facilities maintenance, grounds management, capital improvement projects, compliance, vendor relationships, safety compliance, and operational support services. This position is ideal for a hands-on leader with experience in facilities management, construction, property management, or building operations who can balance strategic planning with day-to-day operational oversight.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Facilities & Property Management**

· Provide leadership and oversight for the maintenance, repair, and improvement of all buildings, grounds, utilities, and infrastructure across the retreat center campus.

· Develop and implement preventative maintenance programs to ensure the longevity and reliability of facilities and equipment.

· Develop and maintain a multi-year facilities and building assessment plan with replacement forecast (roofs, HVAC, water/septic, electrical, roadways).

· Manage rural site systems including well, septic/on-site wastewater, water treatment, propane, backup power/generators, private roads, and irrigation, ensuring resilience to wildfire, storm, and extended-outage conditions.

· Coordinate and supervise facility improvement projects, renovations, and construction activities from planning through completion.

· Conduct regular inspections of buildings and grounds and establish priorities for repairs and upgrades.

· Ensure compliance with all applicable safety, health, environmental, and building regulations.

**Construction & Capital Projects**

· Manage capital improvement projects, including budgeting, contractor selection, scheduling, and quality control.

· Serve as the primary liaison with architects, engineers, contractors, inspectors, and vendors.

· Develop project scopes, obtain bids, review contracts, and monitor project progress.

· Maintain long-range facility and infrastructure improvement plans aligned with organizational priorities.

· Evaluate facility systems and recommend upgrades to improve efficiency, sustainability, and guest experience.

**Operations Leadership**

· Oversee operational support functions including maintenance, housekeeping, kitchen and facility readiness for retreats and events.

· Develop and implement operational procedures to ensure efficient, consistent, and safe facility operations.

· Coordinate logistics to support retreat programs, guest groups, and special events.

· Ensure facilities are prepared and functioning properly to support all scheduled activities.

**Team Leadership**

· Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate maintenance, housekeeping, kitchen and support staff.

· Foster a collaborative culture of accountability, stewardship, and service.

· Establish work schedules, assign priorities, and ensure effective staff coverage.

· Promote safe work practices and ongoing professional development.

**Financial & Vendor Management**

· Assist in the development and management of facility, operations, and capital budgets.

· Monitor expenditures and identify opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiencies.

· Solicit and evaluate vendor proposals and negotiate service agreements.

· Manage relationships with contractors, suppliers, and service providers to ensure quality work and cost-effective solutions.

**Guest & Retreat Experience**

· Ensure retreat guests experience a safe, clean, comfortable, and welcoming environment.

· Collaborate with retreat and program staff to align facility operations with guest and event needs.

· Address facility-related concerns promptly and professionally.

**Administrative Responsibilities**

· Maintain accurate records related to maintenance activities, inspections, projects, vendor contracts, and regulatory compliance.

· Prepare reports and recommendations regarding facility conditions, capital needs, and operational improvements.

· Support organizational initiatives and special events as requested.

**Qualifications Required**

· Minimum of 2 years of experience in facilities management, construction management, property management, building operations, or a related field.

· Demonstrated experience supervising maintenance personnel, contractors, or operational teams.

· Strong knowledge of building systems, preventative maintenance practices, safety procedures, and facility operations.

· Proven project management skills, including budgeting, scheduling, and contractor oversight.

· Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities.

· Ability to prioritize multiple projects and respond effectively to operational needs.

**Preferred**

· Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Construction Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

· Experience in hospitality, retreat centers, camp and conference centers, educational campuses, nonprofit organizations, or mission-driven environments.

· Background in commercial construction, renovation projects, or capital improvement management with knowledge of older infrastructure.

· Knowledge of and/or desire to learn water system operation.

· CPR/First Aid certification.

**Work Environment**

· Requires regular physical presence throughout the retreat center campus.

· Frequent walking across buildings and grounds, including uneven outdoor terrain.

· Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and perform occasional physical inspections of facilities and equipment.

· Availability for occasional evenings, weekends, and emergency response situations as operational needs require.

Pay: $90,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

identity_held_roles.title: IT Director of Quality Assurance
identity_held_roles.description:
**ABOUT ETHOS & THE OPPORTUNITY**

Ethos Risk Services is a leading insurance claims investigation and medical management company focused on delivering better data, technology, and insights that help our clients make better decisions. We are continuing to invest in our technology organization and are seeking an experienced engineering leader to help scale how software is built, tested, and delivered.

We are seeking a **full-time Director of Quality Assurance** to own software quality across Ethos, overseeing an outsourced QA team and the processes, tooling, environments, and metrics that prevent defects from reaching production. Our ideal candidate is an experienced, results-driven QA leader who will establish a consistent defect lifecycle, reduce defect aging, implement effective root cause analysis and preventive measures, and improve the reliability of test environments. Within their first year, they will standardize QA tools and processes, integrate AI-based solutions into daily QA operations and performance tracking, and establish a comprehensive KPI framework that drives measurable improvements in software quality, efficiency, and accountability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Lead Outsourced QA Operations:** Direct the day-to-day activities of an outsourced QA team of 8 to10 resources, establishing priorities, performance expectations, and accountability for quality deliverables.
* **Manage Vendor Performance:** Oversee vendor agreements, SLAs, staffing, onboarding, and performance evaluations. Address performance gaps through corrective action and ensure effective knowledge transfer and documentation.
* **Drive Defect Management:** Establish and enforce standardized defect tracking, classification, prioritization, and resolution processes. Lead regular defect triage with engineering and product teams to manage backlogs and identify quality risks.
* **Prevent Production Issues:** Lead structured root cause analysis of production defects, identify recurring failure patterns, and implement preventive measures through improved test coverage, regression testing, and quality gates.
* **Oversee Test Environments:** Partner with DevOps to maintain stable, production-representative QA, staging, and UAT environments, including configuration standards, test data management, and environment availability.
* **Define QA Strategy & Standards:** Develop and continuously improve QA processes across manual, automated, regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to strengthen quality and consistency.
* **Advance Test Automation:** Evaluate and implement QA tools and automation frameworks, integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and release reliability.
* **Leverage AI-Enabled QA Tools:** Apply AI-based solutions to test generation, defect classification, failure analysis, workload management, and performance monitoring. Evaluate emerging tools and implement solutions that deliver measurable improvements while maintaining appropriate security and accuracy controls.
* **Establish Quality KPIs:** Define and monitor performance metrics, including defect escape rates, resolution times, automation coverage, recurring production incidents, test effectiveness, and vendor SLA adherence.
* **Deliver Executive Reporting:** Produce monthly quality reports and quarterly reviews for the VP of Engineering and CTO, translating performance data into actionable insights, risks, trends, and recommendations.
* **Support Release Readiness:** Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, IT Delivery Leads, and Technical Product Owners to integrate QA into sprint and release planning, assess release quality, and recommend readiness for deployment.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (required).

**Required Experience:**

* 8 to 10 years of progressively greater responsibility in software quality assurance.
* 3 to 4 years in a QA management role leading teams and managers.
* Proven expertise in defect lifecycle management, root cause analysis, and preventive quality practices.
* Hands-on experience establishing and maintaining test environments and test data management practices.
* Strong working knowledge of QA tooling, such as test management (e.g., Xray, Zephyr, TestRail), defect tracking (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps), and automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress).
* Practical experience using AI-based tools in QA or team management, and enthusiasm for expanding their use.
* Experience defining QA KPIs and producing executive-level monthly and quarterly reporting.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into delivery workflows.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Performance, security, or API testing, and a regulated-industry background.
* Certifications: ISTQB Advanced or Test Manager, CSQE, or similar.
* Experience with data visualization or dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)

**WORKING AT ETHOS**

This is a 100% remote U.S.-based role, offering the flexibility to work from home while remaining closely connected to a collaborative leadership team. Our ideal candidate is available during EST standard business hours. Occasional travel may be required for quarterly or annual leadership meetings and company events.

**Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States and must not require current or future employment sponsorship.**

**Benefits include:** Paid Time Off and Sick Time **|** Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance **|** Short-Term + Long-Term Disability Insurance + Life Insurance **|** 401(k) Matching **|** Employee Referral Bonus Program

At Ethos, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, shape the future of our engineering organization, and help build the systems and processes that support our next stage of growth. **To learn more about Ethos, visit our website:** https://ethosrisk.com/about-us/

*Ethos Risk Services is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.*

existing_roles.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is looking for an experienced Senior Director of Quality to join our battery manufacturing organization. In this role you will lead the Quality department for Form Energy. Your scope will be company-wide and your team will implement systems and processes that ensure products are designed, manufactured and shipped to the highest levels of performance, reliability, and quality.

This role is for an executive leader with experience developing new technologies and bringing high-volume manufacturing facilities to life. You will provide vision, strategy and leadership to help Form achieve manufacturing scale, cost-reduction, and daily operation execution.

As the key driver for shipping the highest quality products, you will thrive when working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from early R&D to validation testing, pilot builds, and ultimately commercial production of customer-facing products.

*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Develop and sustain a world-class quality management system powered by a highly-trained, flexible, and proactive staff
* Maintain product risk profiles and manage quality systems to ensure Form Energy is meeting or exceeding risk expectations
* Ensure Form Energy production operations are releasing only conforming products to our customers
* Communicate key risks and opportunities to leadership and provide direction to resolve top issues and drive definitive corrective action
* Plan and efficiently manage Quality resources (labor, OpEx, and CapEx) and report on department performance and needs
* Communicate Form Energy's commitment to quality with internal and external interested parties
* Drive a customer-focused culture anchored by strong individual ownership and accountability

### **What you'll bring:**

* At least 10 years experience in quality, manufacturing, or manufacturing engineering
* At least 5 years in a senior-leader / site-leader quality role, demonstrating a clear record of success in building industry-leading teams that can execute in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Expertise in building Quality Management Systems (e.g., IATF 16949, ISO9001).
* Highly technical background, with a strong foundation in logical reasoning that allows for a steep learning curve and the ability to adapt to new technologies
* Excellent leadership, project management, communication, and organizational skills
* Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in Engineering

### **Where you'll work:**

This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. **Relocation assistance is available.**

*#LI-Onsite*

*Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.*

*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*

*To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.*

*If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.*  
  
*Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

Carton Service CSI, LLC | Shelby, OH | Full-time, salaried (exempt) | On-site with occasional travel

**About Us**

Our site runs a food safety management system built to the SQF Food Safety Code (Edition 9). To learn more about us, visit www.cartonservice.com.

**The Role**

Reporting to the President, the Quality Assurance Director leads quality assurance across all our carton production. You'll make sure our products meet customer specifications and expectations, keep our quality and food safety systems current, and drive cost-effective quality improvements as a key contributor to our strategic plans.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and develop the QA team and oversee the plant quality system
* Review and approve customer specs, and make sure CSI procedures are followed
* Conduct and document internal, supplier and customer audits, manage our FSC and IMS certifications, and serve as backup SQF Practitioner
* Champion GMPs for food-contact packaging, from low-migration inks to hygiene
* Represent us with customers and suppliers, and partner with internal departments, including Sales and Production

**What You Bring**

* College education in a related field (bachelor's degree preferred)
* 5+ years experience working in a GFSI Certified production plant, preferably packaging
* Proven success leading teams, including cross-functional teams
* Strong communication skills with associates, customers, suppliers and regulators
* Organized and results-driven, able to manage multiple priorities and people

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with SQF, BRCGS or another GFSI food safety program
* FSC chain-of-custody or IMS program experience
* SQF Practitioner, HACCP or auditor training; Microsoft Access skills

**Work Environment**

Office work plus time on the production floor (noise, moving machinery; PPE required) and occasional travel to customer and supplier sites. Must be able to stand, walk, bend and kneel frequently and lift up to 25 lbs.

**What We Offer**

* Salary commensurate with experience
* Medical, Rx, dental and vision insurance
* Short- and long-term disability
* 9 paid holidays plus vacation
* 401(k)

**Ready to Apply?**

Apply through Indeed or send your resume and salary expectations to resume@cartonservice.com.

*Carton Service CSI, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Experience:

* quality (GFSI certified): 5 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

existing_roles.description:
**Summary**

Provides strategic leadership and direction for the Quality organization, ensuring that quality systems, processes, and practices support business objectives, customer requirements, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence. Establishes quality strategy, policies, objectives, and performance expectations and provides leadership across functions to drive continuous improvement, strengthen quality performance, mitigate risk, and support business growth.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership and direction for the Quality organization, establishing priorities, objectives, and performance expectations aligned with business and operational goals.
* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the site's Quality Management System and associated quality policies, procedures, and controls.
* Serve as the site's senior quality leader and management representative for applicable ISO 9001, AS9100, and ISO 13485 quality management systems.
* Ensure continued compliance with applicable regulatory, customer, industry, and certification requirements, including applicable FDA, ITAR, ISO, and IPC requirements and standards.
* Provide leadership for quality planning related to processes, products, customers, and business requirements, with consideration for broader corporate quality objectives.
* Establish and monitor quality metrics and performance indicators. Identify trends, risks, and systemic issues and lead actions to improve quality performance.
* Provide quality performance, risk, and improvement recommendations to site and organizational leadership.
* Lead the Material Review Board (MRB) process and provide oversight for the disposition and control of nonconforming material and product.
* Provide leadership and oversight for corrective and preventive actions, root cause analysis, and systemic problem resolution in partnership with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and other functions.
* Lead quality improvement initiatives focused on reducing defects, improving process capability, increasing throughput, and strengthening overall operational performance.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality ownership throughout the organization.
* Provide oversight of internal and external audit activities, certification requirements, customer audits, and resulting corrective actions.
* Partner with Supply Chain and suppliers to evaluate supplier quality performance, address quality risks, and ensure supplier quality systems meet business and customer requirements.
* Oversee the calibration system and applicable preventive maintenance controls to ensure compliance and effectiveness.
* Ensure appropriate training and organizational capability related to workmanship standards, acceptance criteria, quality systems, and regulatory/customer requirements.
* Support environmental management requirements, including applicable ISO 14001 responsibilities and site environmental management activities.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and other functions to identify and mitigate quality and operational risks and improve customer outcomes.
* Provide quality leadership and expertise in support of new products, customers, programs, processes, and business opportunities.
* Promote awareness and understanding of regulatory, customer, and quality requirements throughout the organization.
* Lead, develop, and mentor Quality leaders and team members, building organizational capability and ensuring appropriate talent development and succession planning.
* Support corporate and site Lean/6S objectives and integrate quality principles into continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support and follow all applicable Quality Management System requirements related to quality, environmental, health, safety, and security.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Job Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Advanced knowledge of quality management systems and quality principles within a complex manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 13485, and other applicable regulatory and customer quality requirements.
* Working knowledge of FDA, ITAR, IPC, and applicable electronics manufacturing standards and requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into quality strategies, priorities, metrics, and improvement initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of corrective action, root cause analysis, risk management, process improvement, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to analyze quality and operational data, identify trends and systemic risks, and develop effective corrective and preventive strategies.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to balance quality, customer, operational, financial, and business considerations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive results across functions without relying solely on direct authority.
* Strong leadership and organizational capability, including experience building, developing, and leading professional and technical teams.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customers, regulatory bodies, auditors, suppliers, and senior leadership.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and applicable electronic manufacturing and quality systems.

**Experience/Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations, or a related technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible quality, engineering, or manufacturing experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience leading a quality organization within a complex manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent technical, quality, and operational priorities.
* Demonstrated experience influencing cross-functional leaders and driving organization-wide quality and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience interacting with customers, auditors, regulatory organizations, and senior business leadership.
* Demonstrated balance of strategic thinking, strong analytical capability, and effective execution.
* Strong business judgment, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication skills.

**Due to ITAR and / or CUI compliance, this position requires candidates to be a U.S. Citizen.**

Benefits Offered: Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental and vision coverage; company-paid basic life/AD&D insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance; voluntary supplemental insurances, flexible spending accounts and employee assistance program (EAP). Sick Leave, Vacation Time, and company-paid Holidays are also provided as paid time off. NEOTech also provides a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan option with a company match.

NEOTech is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

NEOTech has a long-standing commitment to maintaining a safe, quality-oriented and productive work environment. We also want all employees to perform their duties safely and efficiently, in a manner that protects their interests and those of their co-workers. We recognize that alcohol and drug abuse pose a threat to the health and safety of NEOTech employees and to the security of the Company’s equipment and facilities. For these reasons, NEOTech is committed to the elimination of drug and alcohol use and abuse in the workplace. Candidates being considered for hire must pass a pre-employment background check and drug test which include screening for illegal drugs and marijuana.

existing_roles.description:
Are you a quality leader who enjoys building systems, developing teams, and creating a culture of continuous improvement? Advantic Building Group is seeking a Director of Quality to lead enterprise-wide quality strategy, establish a scalable Quality Management System (QMS), drive ISO 9001 certification efforts, and partner with leaders across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and field operations to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. This is a unique opportunity to build and shape the future of quality within a growing organization.

At Advantic Building Group, we design, fabricate, and install innovative Fiber Reinforced Polymer (FRP) structural systems that help our customers build smarter, safer, and more efficiently.

But what truly sets Advantic apart isn’t just what we build — it’s **how** we work and **who** we work with.

We're a team that values ownership, camaraderie, and curiosity. We roll up our sleeves, tackle challenges together, and support one another along the way. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a quality leader who shares those values and can help strengthen the culture we've built while establishing the systems, processes, and accountability necessary to deliver exceptional quality outcomes for our customers.

**Why Join Advantic?**

* Lead the development of a scalable enterprise-wide Quality Management System (QMS)
* Drive Advantic's ISO 9001 certification journey
* Influence quality across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and field operations
* Build and develop a growing quality organization
* Partner directly with senior leadership to shape strategic initiatives
* Make a visible impact on customer success, operational excellence, and company growth

  

**Role Summary**

The Director of Quality provides strategic leadership for quality across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, assembly, and field operations. This role is responsible for developing and executing Advantic Building Group's quality strategy, building a scalable Quality Management System (QMS), leading ISO 9001 certification efforts, and driving continuous improvement throughout the organization.

This leader partners closely with operations, engineering, supply chain, and project teams to reduce defects, improve process performance, strengthen customer confidence, and support the company's growth objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Leadership and Strategic Planning**

* Develop and execute a quality roadmap aligned with business growth, customer commitments, operational risks, and manufacturing and construction requirements; set annual objectives, priorities, and resource needs, including staffing, inspection equipment, and quality technology.
* Report quality performance, emerging risks, and cost of poor quality (scrap, rework, field repairs, returns, warranty) to senior leadership with clear owners, deadlines, and escalation expectations, and partner with Operations and Delivery to reduce it.

**Quality Management Systems (QMS) & ISO 9001 Leadership**

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve Advantic's Quality Management System (QMS), while leading ISO 9001 certification readiness, certification audits, surveillance audits, and recertification activities.
* Build a scalable, practical Quality Management System that enables operational consistency, supports growth, improves customer satisfaction, and achieves ISO 9001 certification.
* Govern document, configuration, and revision control across engineering drawings, submittals, production information, and field documentation, and ensure quality records are reliable and accessible across ERP, MES, and document systems with defined data ownership.

**Manufacturing Quality, Process Control & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish inspection and test plans, acceptance criteria, and release controls for incoming materials, in-process fabrication, final assembly, packaging, and pre-shipment verification, ensuring products conform to approved drawings, engineering requirements, customer specifications, and applicable contractual and industry requirements.
* Partner with Operations on specification review, design reviews, process risk assessments, first-build validation, and readiness for new or changed products and processes; coordinate qualified technical resources when specialized expertise is needed.
* Define traceability, inspection records, measuring equipment controls, calibration, and measurement method validation appropriate to risk and application.
* Establish controls for FRP materials and structural assemblies, including storage, handling, fabrication, and special processes.

**Corrective Actions, Root Cause Analysis & Quality Improvement**

* Lead the enterprise nonconformance and corrective action process, including containment, material disposition, root cause analysis, escalation management, and verification of corrective action effectiveness across internal, supplier, customer, and field-related issues.
* Exercise authority under approved procedures to quarantine material, hold shipments, or stop affected work when conformity is in question; coordinate technical dispositions and obtain required customer approval for concessions or deviations, while maintaining independence of quality decisions.

**Supplier, Subcontractor, & Field Quality Management**

* Partner with Supply Chain to establish supplier qualification, approval, audit, and performance monitoring, including quality requirements for outsourced services and subcontracted work, and maintain approval status in the approved supplier system.
* Ensure certifications, traceability, inspection evidence, and customer requirements are flowed down to suppliers and verified.
* Lead supplier corrective actions and improvement plans, and support cost recovery within established commercial authority.
* Develop the field quality program for construction management and data center white space work, including project quality plan templates, inspection and test plan requirements, hold and witness points, and documentation standards that on-site QC managers must follow.
* Set expectations for, train, and hold on-site QC managers accountable to the program through project kickoffs, periodic field audits, and review of inspection records, field non-conformances, and punch list and turnover documentation.
* Serve as the escalation point for field quality issues and the senior quality contact for customers and third-party inspectors during audits and handover.

  

**Performance Measures**

* Establish baselines, targets, and reporting definitions with leadership. Measures include first-pass yield, scrap and rework, cost of poor quality, nonconformance recurrence and closure time, corrective action effectiveness, supplier performance, customer complaints, field deficiencies, audit completion, calibration compliance, and progress against the quality roadmap.

  

**People Leadership and Shared Accountability**

* Lead hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and development of quality personnel, with training matrices, competency expectations, and succession plans.
* Partner with operational leaders to build quality awareness across the organization, and hold process owners accountable through agreed governance and escalation, reinforcing that each department owns the quality of its work.
* Model Ownership, Camaraderie, and Curiosity through clear expectations, respectful challenge, and consistent follow-through.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent directly relevant experience.
* Ten or more years of progressive quality experience, including five or more years leading a quality team or function in manufacturing or a comparable technical environment.
* Demonstrated success building, implementing, or significantly improving Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Experience leading ISO 9001 implementation, certification readiness, and managing internal, customer, and third-party audits.
* Proven results developing people, leading change across departments, and reducing defects, repeat failures, or quality-related costs.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and inspection requirements; practical knowledge of measurement systems, traceability, process controls, and structured problem-solving.
* Experience using ERP, MES, electronic quality systems, or comparable tools to establish dependable workflows and actionable reporting.
* Ability to communicate clearly with customers, frontline employees, and senior leaders; make sound decisions under pressure; and resolve competing quality, schedule, and business priorities.

  

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience with FRP or composite products, structural fabrication, engineered assemblies, construction quality, or mission-critical and data center projects.
* Experience connecting manufacturing quality with field installation, subcontractor oversight, customer acceptance, and project turnover.
* ASQ CMQ/OE, CQE, or CQA certification; ISO 9001 lead auditor qualification; or Lean Six Sigma training with demonstrated application.

  

**Physical demands**

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to communicate effectively through speaking and listening. The role typically involves prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, and lift or move objects up to 15 pounds.

*Advantic Building Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*
