**Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations leads the development, execution, and growth of SANY America’s component remanufacturing and full-machine refurbishment operations. This position oversees shop performance, safety, quality, cost, inventory, suppliers, and dealer support while building a scalable, profitable operation that improves machine uptime and lifecycle value.

With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase their market share.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Business Strategy & Operations**

* Develop and execute the U.S. remanufacturing and refurbishment roadmap, including future certified refurbished equipment programs.

* Direct production planning, technician utilization, shop capacity, workflows, turnaround times, and performance standards.

* Build and coach technical and operations teams, establishing clear ownership, training, and accountability.

**Remanufacturing & Refurbishment**

* Standardize machine inspection, teardown, repair, component replacement, testing, cosmetic restoration, and final acceptance.

* Expand viable remanufacturing offerings for engines, hydraulics, powertrain, electronics, and other high-value assemblies.

* Establish documented repair procedures, quality gates, testing standards, failure analysis, and corrective actions.

**Financial & Inventory Management**

* Own operating budgets, rebuild costs, labor standards, margin performance, scrap reduction, and repair-versus-replace decisions.

* Develop core return, valuation, salvage, used-component, and reman inventory controls to improve recovery and reduce working capital.

* Track operational and financial KPIs, including cycle time, capacity, first-pass quality, revenue, and profitability.

**Suppliers, Dealers & Cross-Functional Support**

* Manage outside rebuild suppliers and technical partners against quality, cost, warranty, and lead-time expectations.

* Partner with Service, Parts, Warranty, Product, Sales, Finance, and dealers to support customer uptime and refurbishment opportunities.

* Support certified refurbished equipment programs through condition grading, inspection documentation, and warranty coordination.

**Safety & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain a safe, organized, compliant shop with appropriate PPE, equipment controls, and safe work practices.

* Implement Lean, 5S, standard work, visual management, root cause analysis, and ongoing process improvements.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

* 12+ years of progressive experience in remanufacturing, refurbishment, heavy equipment, automotive, industrial manufacturing, service operations, or a related field.

* 6+ years of direct people-management or operations-leadership experience.

* Strong understanding of engines, hydraulics, powertrain, electrical systems, and heavy equipment troubleshooting.

* Proven ability to manage production, quality, inventory, capacity, costs, KPIs, and financial performance.

* Strong communication, problem-solving, cross-functional leadership, and analytical skills.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience launching or expanding remanufacturing, machine rebuild, refurbishment, or certified pre-owned operations.

* Construction or off-highway equipment experience, including supplier and third-party rebuild partner management.

* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, ERP, inventory, service, and warranty system experience.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

**OFFICE + OPERATIONS WORK ENVIRONMENT**

This role is primarily office-based with regular work in remanufacturing, refurbishment, and equipment service areas. Duties may involve extended computer use, standing, walking, and observing or inspecting heavy machinery, tools, and shop operations. Exposure to noise, moving equipment, and varying temperatures may occur. Required personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel to SANY facilities, suppliers, dealers, and customer sites as business needs require.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience.

* Medical, dental, and vision

* Paid Time Off

* 401(k) savings plans

* Health Savings Account (HSA)

* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

* Company paid STD and LTD benefits

* Life Insurance

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Applicants may be required to complete pre-employment screenings, including drug and/or alcohol testing, as a condition of employment where permitted by applicable law. existing_roles.title: Director NPI/PLM
existing_roles.description:
**Director, New Product Introduction (NPI) & Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)**

Round Rock, Texas | Onsite | Full-Time

**Reports to:** CFO/CEO

**Works closely with:** Director of Operations/Engineering/R&D, Quality, Purchasing, Production, Program Management and external suppliers

**Travel:** Approximately 25%-35%, primarily to supplier locations

**Role structure:** Hands-on director role; initially an individual contributor leading cross-functional work

**Role Summary**

The Director of NPI & PLM leads the transition of new and modified products from development into stable production. The role coordinates product documentation, supplier readiness, pilot builds, production handoff and lifecycle changes across Ametrine and its manufacturing partners.

This position is focused on practical execution. The Director will work directly with cut-and-sew partners and other suppliers to ensure products can be produced repeatedly at the required quality, capacity and schedule. The role also helps develop alternate sources and contingency plans across fabric, metallization, printing, DWR treatment and cut-and-sew operations.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**New Product Introduction**

* Maintain the NPI schedule for new products, product changes and manufacturing transfers.
* Coordinate requirements, design release, sourcing, prototype builds, pilot production, validation and production handoff.
* Use clear stage gates, owners, due dates and readiness checklists.
* Identify schedule, supplier, material, quality and capacity risks early and drive actions to closure.
* Provide concise status updates covering progress, open decisions, risks and next steps.

**Prototype-to-Production Transfer**

* Work with Engineering and R&D to review designs for manufacturability and production readiness.
* Prepare or coordinate BOMs, routings, work instructions, technical packages, inspection points and packaging requirements.
* Lead prototype, pilot and first-production builds at Ametrine and supplier locations.
* Capture lessons learned and ensure changes are reflected in released documentation.
* Confirm that Operations and suppliers are ready before a product is released to routine production.

**Cut-and-Sew and Supplier Readiness**

* Work onsite with cut-and-sew partners to establish and improve production methods.
* Review patterns, sewing specifications, fixtures, templates, work instructions and inspection requirements.
* Assess supplier labor, equipment, training, floor space, quality controls and available capacity.
* Develop practical ramp plans and verify production rates through actual builds.
* Support supplier training and resolve manufacturability, throughput and quality issues during launch.
* Track supplier actions and escalate missed commitments or unsupported plans.

**Product Lifecycle Management**

* Maintain control of released BOMs, specifications, approved materials, suppliers, routings and product revisions.
* Coordinate engineering changes and assess their impact on inventory, suppliers, schedule, testing and customer requirements.
* Ensure the correct product configuration is used for each order and customer.
* Support PLM process and system improvements, including appropriate integration with ERP/MRP.
* Maintain orderly lifecycle records from product introduction through sustainment and retirement.

**Supply-Chain Resilience**

* Maintain a process-level supply-chain map covering fabric, metallization, printing, DWR, cut and sew, accessories and final delivery.
* Identify bottlenecks, long-lead items, single-source dependencies and supplier-capacity risks.
* Develop and qualify alternate sources where practical.
* Create contingency plans for specialized processes that cannot be economically dual-sourced.
* Coordinate source qualification with Operations, Purchasing, Engineering and Quality.
  

**Quality and Process Control**

* Partner with Quality to define process controls, inspection requirements and first-article expectations.
* Support supplier qualification, process reviews, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Monitor first-pass yield, defects, rework and launch-related issues.
* Ensure production methods remain consistent with approved documentation and customer requirements.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Lead NPI work through influence across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Purchasing and suppliers.
* Maintain clear owners, deadlines and escalation paths.
* Coordinate with the Director of Operations so new-product timelines and supplier readiness are aligned with the production plan.
* Support communication and coordination between Ametrine Inc. and Ametrine Ltd. where product development activities overlap.

**Success Measures**

* NPI milestones completed on schedule
* Prototype-to-pilot and pilot-to-production cycle time
* Supplier readiness and capacity verification completed before launch
* Percentage of critical supply-chain nodes with an alternate source or documented contingency
* Launch first-pass yield, rework and defect performance
* Completeness and accuracy of BOMs, routings, work instructions and product revisions
* Timely closure of supplier, manufacturing-readiness and lifecycle risks

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, industrial technology, textiles, supply chain or a related field; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered.
* Eight or more years of relevant experience in NPI, manufacturing engineering, supplier development, PLM, product transfer or contract manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience moving physical products from prototype through pilot and into production.
* Experience working directly with external manufacturers or suppliers.
* Working knowledge of BOMs, routings, work instructions, engineering changes and configuration control.
* Experience with ERP/MRP and PLM or related product-data systems.
* Strong project planning, follow-through, problem-solving and written communication skills.
* Ability to work onsite in Round Rock and travel approximately 25%-35%.
* U.S. citizenship required due to the defense-related nature of the company’s work.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with technical textiles, sewn products, outdoor equipment, military products, automotive soft goods, medical textiles, inflatables or related manufacturing.
* Experience with cut-and-sew production methods, patterns, line balancing or labor standards.
* Experience with coated, laminated, printed or metallized fabrics.
* Defense, aerospace or government-contract manufacturing experience.
* Experience qualifying secondary suppliers or developing business-continuity plans.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, APICS or similar certification.

**Working Style**

* Hands-on and comfortable working at supplier facilities and on production floors
* Organized, practical and attentive to manufacturing details
* Able to communicate effectively with engineers, operators, supplier managers and company leadership
* Persistent in following actions through completion
* Comfortable balancing several product introductions and production issues at the same time
* Focused on building useful processes without unnecessary bureaucracy

Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we're building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions.

We're not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and threats grow more complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, and Satellite Operations for top-tier space operators and allied defense organizations.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI, your impact starts here.

LeoLabs is seeking a Head of Manufacturing to lead the next phase of production scaling of our radar systems. This leader will own the manufacturing strategy, industrialization roadmap, quality management, facility scaling, and cross-functional execution required to increase production capacity beyond 10x. This role may be leveled as Senior Director or Vice President level based on the successful candidate’s experience, leadership scope and demonstrated ability to own the function. The role with report directly to the SVP, Radars. This role is a full-time, in-person position based at our headquarters in Menlo Park, CA. Regular domestic travel is expected.

The Head of Manufacturing will turn LeoLabs’ advanced radar designs from low/medium-rate initial production into repeatable, scalable, high-rate production systems. You will collaborate with and leverage support from Product, Supply Chain, Radar Systems and Hardware Engineering, Program Management, Finance and Accounting, and executive leadership to build the manufacturing capacity that enables LeoLabs to deploy radar systems more reliably and at greater scale for the U.S. Government, allies, and commercial customers.

The preferred candidate has done this before – they are a leader who has built and sustained a manufacturing system, rather than someone who has only managed an existing operation. This candidate is a hands-on manufacturing executive or emerging executive from a high-performance production environment such as aerospace, defense technology, automotive, or other complex hardware industries. They have scaled production systems from the ground up, built functional teams, improved quality, stood up facilities or production lines, and operated with urgency in environments where reliability, repeatability, and mission success matter.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Strategy & Scale

* Own LeoLabs’ high-rate manufacturing and industrialization strategy for radar systems, subsystems, and associated high-reliability hardware across manufacturing, assembly, integration, and test operations.
* Build and scale a production system and team capable of supporting 10x growth in radar production over the next 2 years while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, integration, and deployment readiness.
* Define the operating model across internal manufacturing, external suppliers, contract manufacturing, and integration partners.
* Own the high-rate production footprint plan including facility needs, equipment, tooling, staffing, and capital investment.

Industrialization

* Own the transition from engineering builds to production-ready designs.
* Establish and mature release and readiness gates, first-article processes, and build documentation.
* Partner with Radar Systems and Hardware Engineering teams to industrialize new radar designs, ensuring manufacturability, testability, serviceability, configuration control, and production readiness.
* Partner with engineering NPI manufacturing team to improve manufacturability, DfX, and cost reduction opportunities.
* Ensure new radar products have validated build plans, test procedures, tooling, factory acceptance testing criteria, and supplier plans before production ramp.
* Create a functioning feedback system from manufacturing and sustainment back into product and engineering.

Quality, Reliability & Production

* Build and mature the quality management system required for high-reliability radar systems serving mission-critical customers.
* Establish clear standards for configuration control, traceability, inspection, nonconformance management, corrective action, supplier quality, and production acceptance.
* Drive measurable improvements in yield, first-pass quality, rework, scrap, field defects, and schedule performance.
* Build strong review mechanisms for failures, escapes, production risks, and systemic issues.
* Partner with Technical Program Management to align production readiness and execution with program, contract, customer, and deployment commitments
* Partner with Supply Chain on supplier readiness, long-lead planning, cost reduction, and risk mitigation.
* Partner with the Radar Operations Center and Global Infrastructure to turn field performance and maintenance data into product and process improvements to increase performance, reduce operational impacts, and decrease maintenance costs.
* Develop manufacturing KPIs and high-level dashboards for throughput, schedule metrics, yield, labor tracking, cost, quality, rework, scrap, supplier performance, and field reliability.

Team Leadership

* Establish and lead the LeoLabs Production System, creating a common operating model for safety, quality, delivery, cost and people. Implement tiered daily management, visual controls, standard work, structured problem solving, leader standard work, production flow, capacity management and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, develop, and lead a world-class manufacturing organization including manufacturing operations, production, test operations, quality, facilities, and related functions.
* Set clear ownership and metrics across the manufacturing organization.
* Build a culture of execution, urgency, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

* Demonstrated experience implementing and leading a mature Lean manufacturing or production operating system, such as the Toyota Production System, including standard work, visual management, daily accountability, structured problem solving, flow, built-in quality, waste reduction and continuous improvement.

**About Sidor Ventures**

Sidor Ventures is a growing McDonald's franchise organization operating four restaurants throughout Seminole County, Florida, and employing more than 200 team members.

We are building a high-performance organization centered on operational excellence, accountability, leadership development, and an exceptional customer experience.

As we continue expanding, we are seeking an exceptional, results-driven Director of Operations / Multi-Unit Supervisor to lead restaurant performance, develop our General Managers, and help drive the next phase of our organization's growth.

**This is an opportunity to play a significant leadership role in a growing franchise organization, work directly with ownership, and help shape the future of the business.**

**Position Overview**

The Director of Operations / Multi-Unit Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the operational, financial, and people performance of multiple McDonald's restaurants.

We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on leader who can develop high-performing General Managers, establish consistent operating standards, improve restaurant profitability, and build a strong leadership pipeline.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional operational knowledge with strong financial acumen, sound judgment, and a proven ability to lead through others.

This position works directly with ownership and will play a critical role in strengthening our existing restaurants while supporting future expansion.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership and operational oversight across multiple McDonald's restaurants.
* Ensure consistent execution of McDonald's brand standards, Quality, Service, and Cleanliness (QSC).
* Drive measurable improvements in service times, order accuracy, customer satisfaction, and overall restaurant performance.
* Conduct regular restaurant visits, operational assessments, and performance reviews.
* Identify operational challenges, develop corrective action plans, and ensure sustained improvement.
* Maintain strong food safety, workplace safety, and regulatory compliance standards.
* Establish consistent operating procedures and accountability across the organization.

**Financial Performance & Profitability**

* Take ownership of restaurant-level financial performance, profitability, and controllable expenses.
* Analyze restaurant P&Ls, sales trends, guest counts, labor performance, food costs, and operational metrics.
* Partner with General Managers to develop accurate sales forecasts, labor schedules, and operating budgets.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales growth, operational efficiency, and restaurant profitability.
* Establish clear performance objectives and hold restaurant leadership accountable for results.
* Monitor inventory controls, waste, cash management, and other key financial processes.
* Develop and execute action plans to address underperforming restaurants.

**Leadership Development & Talent Management**

* Directly coach, mentor, and develop restaurant General Managers.
* Establish high expectations for leadership, accountability, communication, and operational execution.
* Identify and develop high-potential managers for future General Manager and multi-unit leadership positions.
* Partner with ownership on recruiting, succession planning, and organizational development.
* Build a strong leadership bench capable of supporting future restaurant acquisitions and new restaurant openings.
* Foster a positive, professional, results-oriented culture across the organization.
* Conduct regular GM performance evaluations and leadership development discussions.

**Strategic Execution & Accountability**

* Work directly with ownership to establish and execute organizational priorities.
* Lead regular business reviews with General Managers, using operational and financial data to drive decisions.
* Ensure timely follow-through on operational initiatives, performance improvement plans, and company standards.
* Proactively identify business risks and opportunities and recommend solutions.
* Support restaurant acquisitions, new restaurant openings, and organizational expansion.
* Maintain consistent, transparent communication with ownership regarding restaurant performance, personnel, and operational priorities.
* Demonstrate professionalism, integrity, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.

**Qualifications - Required**

* Minimum 5 years of progressive restaurant leadership experience, including significant responsibility for high-volume restaurant operations.
* Demonstrated success leading General Managers or multiple restaurant management teams.
* Proven ability to improve operational performance, profitability, and leadership effectiveness.
* Strong understanding of restaurant P&Ls, labor management, food costs, forecasting, and financial controls.
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to interpret performance data, identify root causes, and implement effective action plans.
* Willingness to maintain a consistent, hands-on presence across restaurant locations.
* Ability to travel regularly between restaurants throughout Seminole County, Florida.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Current or previous McDonald's Area Supervisor, Operations Supervisor, or Director of Operations experience.
* Extensive McDonald's restaurant operations background, including General Manager experience.
* Hamburger University training and relevant McDonald's leadership development.
* Experience overseeing multiple high-volume restaurants generating $3 million–$5 million or more in annual sales per location.
* Strong familiarity with McDonald's operating systems, operational metrics, and performance standards.
* Demonstrated success developing General Managers and building management succession pipelines.
* Experience supporting new restaurant openings, acquisitions, or multi-unit organizational growth.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Sidor Ventures offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to attract, reward, and retain exceptional operational leaders.

Our benefits include:

* Competitive base salary
* Performance-based bonus opportunities
* Employer-sponsored health insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer match
* Paid time off
* Professional development and leadership training
* Significant opportunities for professional growth as the organization expands

Specific compensation and benefit details will be discussed during the recruiting process.

**Career Growth**

Sidor Ventures is focused on building a strong, scalable restaurant organization with a long-term commitment to growth.

We are seeking a leader who wants more than a traditional supervisory position. This individual will have the opportunity to help shape our operating culture, develop future leaders, and contribute directly to the organization's expansion.

As we grow, the scope of this position will have the potential to expand alongside the business.

**If you are an accomplished multi-unit restaurant leader who takes pride in developing exceptional teams, driving measurable results, and building a successful organization, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.**

*Sidor Ventures is an equal opportunity employer.*

Pay: $100,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Relocation assistance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

About Us:

### ***Specialized Care for the Patients Who Need It Most.***

NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals (NPH) is dedicated to providing unparalleled service to our patients, team members, physicians, and families. We dare to do things differently, bringing together compassionate care, specialized expertise, and an interdisciplinary approach to meet the unique needs of those we serve. It is this commitment that distinguishes NPH as the healthcare provider of choice.

As a national leader in behavioral healthcare, NPH specializes in caring for patients with acute psychiatric and complex medical needs. Our hospitals provide patient-centered care through an interdisciplinary, multi-specialty approach, ensuring our patients receive the specialized support they need when they need it most.

With locations in Indiana, Michigan, Texas, Ohio, and Arizona, we are expanding access to our unique model of care across the United States. Join NPH and become part of a team that is daring to do things differently and making a lasting difference in the lives of our patients, families, and communities every day.

Overview:

NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals is looking for a Director of Quality and Risk at our **Huber Heights, OH** location. NPH is the national leader in providing medical and neurobehavioral care to patients in acute psychiatric distress. You will be joining a team of rock star staff who provide exceptional, patient-centered care and understand our patients are always our number one priority! The Director of Quality supports the implementation and monitoring of the quality assurance measurements and audits, and assists in improving patient safety processes throughout the hospital through coordinating and engaging in activities to proactively promote implementation of evidence based best practices and resolve deficiencies; plans, develops, and directs system activities and protocols across NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals; helps to prepare NPH facilities for surveys by accrediting and licensing agencies; serves as a resource to all departments and personnel.

**Benefits of joining NPH as a Director of Quality and Risk**

* Competitive pay rates
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* NPH 401(k) plan with up to 4% Company match
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Programs
* Generous PTO and Time Off Policy
* Special tuition offers through Capella University
* Work/life balance with great professional growth opportunities
* Employee Discounts through LifeMart

Responsibilities:

* Implements and monitors quality goals and objectives to measure the organization’s processes and outcomes while administering programs that focus on improved outcomes of patient care or patient safety.
* Interacts with physicians, nurses, department managers, supervisors, and any/all other staff members to provide resource information and identify new opportunities to improve service and reduce costs.
* Generates effectual quality related policies and procedures for the department and hospital that ensures compliance with JC, OSHA, CDC, CMS and other county, state, and federal regulatory agencies.
* Prepares reports, presentations and statistical data that go to the Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement Committee Meetings, facility's administration and other committees as needed. Analyzes data to identify trends and resource utilization for use in optimizing compliance.
* Assists with the annual assessment of the quality control programs from the prior year activities.
* Investigates incidents within the facility and coordinates with the Corporate Quality team to complete the root cause analysis and develop action plans to prevent incidents in the future.
* Establish a structure to ensure that patient care activities are addressed in a coordinated manner involving quality improvement.
* Prepares the agenda for the Quality Council Committee meetings and holds regularly scheduled meetings.
* Provides educational offerings for orientation and on-going in-services.
* Performs mortality reviews in conjunction with the mortality committee and holds regularly scheduled mortality committee meetings.
* Ensures all staff receive proper education on new or revised state and/ or federal regulations or Joint Commission standards.
* Participates in Multi-disciplinary patient centered case conferences, as appropriate.
* Assess and evaluate patients with infections and monitor patient outcomes on an ongoing basis.
* Initiates follow-up on employee/patient exposures to communicable diseases.
* Participates in root-cause analysis, sentinel events, adverse events and identifies trends as directed by regulation. Recommends ways to redesign systems for improvements if needed.
* Oversee Patient Advocacy program.
* Establishes/maintains good relationships with COO, CEO and DON’s and department leaders to promote a cooperative and constructive environment for improvement.
* Promote “Quality is everyone’s business” to gain support, understanding and ownership among staff.
* Other duties as may be assigned.
* Complies with hospital expectations regarding ethical behavior and standards of conduct.
* Complies with federal and hospital requirements in the areas of protected health information & patient privacy.
* Understands and adheres to NPH’s compliance standards as they appear in NPH’s Corporate Compliance Policy, Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest Policy.
* Keeps abreast of all pertinent federal, state and hospital regulations, laws and policies as they presently exist and as they change or are modified.

Qualifications:

* 3+ years of relevant healthcare quality and risk management experience. Prior leadership experience preferred.
* Excellent verbal communication skills necessary in order present quality reports.
* Maintain effective contacts with a variety of Hospital Personnel.
* Professional knowledge of clinical practice, leadership, performance improvement and research statistics in order to conduct surveillance and prepare related reports at a level normally acquired through the completion of a Bachelor’s degree in related field.

Position Title: Quality Manager

Reports To: Plant Manager

Position Summary

The Quality Manager is responsible for the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS) and overall product quality performance. This role focuses on ensuring compliance with AS9100 requirements, driving corrective actions and maintaining consistent quality standards across all operations.

The primary focus of this role is ownership of the QMS, proactive quality leadership and ensuring quality standards are effectively executed in both production and administrative processes.

Project Prioritization & Scope

· Ensure the Quality Management System is maintained, compliant and effectively implemented across the organization.

· Prioritize and drive corrective actions related to customer complaints, internal defects and supplier issues.

· Ensure timely completion of PPAPs, first article inspections and other customer-required quality deliverables.

· Balance time between production floor engagement and administrative quality responsibilities based on business needs.

· Proactively identify quality risks in production and implement containment and corrective actions.

· Prioritize improvement activities based on quality performance metrics, including customer returns, scrap and supplier performance.

· Coordinate with Production, Engineering and other departments to address quality-related risks and issues.

· Ensure nonconforming material is properly controlled, documented and dispositioned in a timely manner.

Key Responsibilities

· Own and maintain the AS9100 Quality Management System, ensuring compliance and effectiveness.

· Lead internal audits and coordinate external audits, including customer and registrar audits.

· Monitor quality performance and address issues impacting product quality in real time.

· Communicate quality performance, risks and significant issues to leadership in a timely manner.

· Perform hands-on inspection of parts as needed to verify quality standards and reinforce expectations.

· Engage with production employees through brief training and coaching conversations to improve quality awareness and execution.

· Lead and drive corrective actions (8D, CARs, SCARs) across departments, ensuring timely completion and effectiveness.

· Serve as the primary point of contact for customer quality issues and responses.

· Oversee supplier performance, including quality, corrective actions and on-time delivery.

· Own, monitor and drive improvement of key quality performance metrics including customer returns, internal scrap and supplier performance.

· Support or perform technical validation activities such as dimensional inspection and laser scanning as required.

· Ensure inspection processes (incoming, in-process, final) are effective and consistently executed.

Implementation & Sustainment

· Ensure quality processes and standards are consistently followed and sustained across all departments.

· Monitor effectiveness of corrective actions and escalate when issues are not resolved.

· Verify that process changes, corrective actions and improvements are properly implemented and maintained.

· Ensure documentation and records within the QMS remain current, accurate and controlled.

Quality System & Process Execution Focus

· Oversee adherence to quality standards across all manufacturing processes.

· Monitor process compliance and identify deviations from established quality requirements.

· Ensure nonconforming material is clearly identified, segregated and controlled.

· Prevent shipment of nonconforming product through effective inspection and process controls.

Training & Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Provide training, coaching and guidance to employees regarding quality standards and expectations.

· Conduct brief, on-the-floor interactions to reinforce quality awareness and correct behaviors.

· Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance and other departments to resolve quality issues.

· Work with Purchasing and suppliers to address supplier-related quality concerns.

· Drive accountability for quality performance across all departments.

· Conduct regular team communication meetings and employee development discussions to support accountability, alignment and performance.

Role Scope & Responsibilities

The following clarifies the scope of this role in relation to other functions within the organization:

· This role owns the Quality Management System and is accountable for its effectiveness and compliance with AS9100 requirements.

· This role is responsible for proactively identifying, initiating and driving corrective actions across all departments.

· This role owns quality outcomes and is responsible for ensuring completion of quality-related activities, regardless of which function performs the work.

· This role is responsible for maintaining a consistent presence on the production floor to verify quality and reinforce standards.

· This role is expected to proactively identify, escalate and drive resolution of quality risks without requiring direction from others.

· This role supports production through quality oversight but does not own production output or scheduling.

· This role is responsible for driving accountability to quality standards across all departments and providing leadership, direction and oversight to quality personnel as organizational needs evolve.

· This role supports product validation activities such as PPAP and inspection but does not own process design, which is the responsibility of the Process Engineer.

· This role is accountable for ensuring nonconforming material processes are followed but relies on cross-functional support for execution of material movement and disposition actions.

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you okay with working in an office setting and on the production floor?

Experience:

* Quality management: 5 years (Required)
* Quality audits: 5 years (Required)

Location:

* Preston, IA 52069 (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Preston, IA 52069 (Required)

Work Location: In person

POSITION SUMMARY
  
  
Will provide strategic leadership, direction, and oversight of the Laguna Healthcare Corporation (LHC) Compliance, Quality Risk Programs, encompassing all clinical, administrative, financial, and medical practice plan functions. This position is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving enterprise-wide programs that ensure adherence to all federal, state, tribal, and accreditation standards. Serve as the primary authority on compliance matters, leads risk mitigation efforts, manages investigations, and champions a culture of ethics, accountability, and transparency. The Director collaborates with leadership, providers, and staff to promote a culture of continuous improvement, patient safety, and accountability. They oversee performance improvement initiatives, incident reporting systems, compliance activities, and risk mitigation strategies to enhance patient outcomes and organizational effectiveness. This position also plays a critical role in integrating culturally responsive care into quality frameworks, supporting health equity, and ensuring services reflect the values, traditions, and needs of the Tribal population served.
  
  
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  
  

* Develop, implement, and oversee LHC’s Compliance, Quality Risk programs, policies, and procedures related to standards of conduct; healthcare laws; billing and reimbursement; fraud, waste, and abuse prevention; privacy and security; quality improvement and other compliance risk areas.
* Lead and facilitate internal committees to drive strategic planning for these programs, setting long- and short-term goals, operational plans, and performance measures.
* Conduct organization-wide quality and risk assessments to identify, prioritize, and mitigate compliance risks and improve overall patient outcomes.
* Monitor compliance with healthcare laws, CMS/OIG regulations, HIPAA/HITECH, and Tribal requirements.
* Oversee sanction screening of employees, contractors, and vendors; ensure organization-wide training on sanction monitoring processes. Ensure credentialing, privileging and provider enrollment program is effective.
* Lead internal audits and compliance reviews to ensure adherence to payer rules, regulatory standards, and organizational policies.
* Develop, in collaboration with the CMO, clinical care guidelines, as well as process and system guidelines.
* Manage confidential reporting channels, including the LHC Compliance Hotline, ensuring proper documentation, investigation, and resolution.
* Conduct or supervise compliance investigations; ensure/coordinate corrective actions with HR, legal counsel, leadership, and managers.
* Serve as the organizational liaison with regulatory agencies during audits, investigations, and compliance inquiries.
* Lead and mentor others in root cause analysis (RCA), healthcare failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) and hazard vulnerability analysis (HVA) teams. Summarize risk management and patient safety data for appropriate evaluation and risk trend analysis.
* Maintain detailed records of compliance efforts, investigative outcomes, and corrective action plans.
* Provide written and verbal compliance reports to executive management, internal Quality Committee, the Board Compliance Committee and the LHC Board of Directors.
* Develop and administer a robust, organization-wide compliance training and education program in conjunction managers and the HR department.
* Lead communication initiatives to promote compliance awareness, ethical conduct, quality management and transparent reporting.
* Provide ongoing consultation to staff and leadership on regulatory requirements and performance improvement measures.
* Develop and coordinate processes to monitor quality of care. Identify opportunities to improve patient care, treatment and services by assisting to implement standard work.
* Oversee accreditation preparation for review by regulatory agencies including AAAHC and/or Joint Commission, educate, and assist department supervisors to maintain appropriate policies and procedures to fulfill requirements and regulations.
* Develop, monitor, and manage department budget.
* Supervise and direct staff and consultants and ensure adequate systems, training and tools to support program goals achievement, performance management and corrective action.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  
  
Five (5) years of progressive experience in healthcare compliance, quality or related healthcare roles. Bachelor Degree in Finance/Accounting, Business, Public or Healthcare Administration or related field of study from an accredited college or university. Master's Degree preferred.
  
  
Certified Professional Compliance Officer (CPCO) preferred, Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC), Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC), or Certified Compliance Ethics Professional (CCEP) or equivalent compliance certification, or eligible for and certification obtained within 12 months as condition of hire. Quality Management certification preferred.
  
  
MANDATORY KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES and COMPETENCIES with proficiency levels
  
  
Ethical Integrity Professionalism — Advanced
  
  
1. Demonstrates unwavering commitment to confidentiality, transparency, and ethical conduct.
  
  
2. Consistently models organizational values and establishes an ethical compliance culture.
  
  
3. Guides organizational decision-making through an ethics-centered approach.
  
  
Regulatory Compliance Expertise — Advanced
  
  
1. Interprets and applies federal, state, and Tribal healthcare regulations with precision.
  
  
2. Advises leadership on complex regulatory issues and emerging compliance risks.
  
  
3. Ensures organizational alignment with OIG, CMS, HIPAA/HITECH, and other regulatory standards.
  
  
Analytical Critical Thinking — Advanced
  
  
1. Uses advanced analytical methods to identify trends, risks, and system vulnerabilities.
  
  
2. Evaluates complex scenarios, synthesizes large volumes of information, and provides clear recommendations.
  
  
3. Leads continuous improvement initiatives using data-driven insights.
  
  
Investigation Problem-Solving — Advanced
  
  

* Conducts or oversees thorough investigations into compliance concerns.
* Demonstrates strong evidence analysis skills and draws objective, well-supported conclusions.
* Designs and monitors corrective action plans to ensure sustainable resolution

Leadership Influence — Advanced
  
  
1. Leads cross-functional teams and committees with confidence and clarity.
  
  
2. Influences organizational behavior through effective communication, coaching, and ethical leadership.
  
  
3. Builds trust and credibility with executives, clinical leaders, and staff.
  
  
Communication Interpersonal Effectiveness — Advanced
  
  
1. Clearly communicates complex regulatory concepts to varied audiences.
  
  
2. Prepares high-quality written reports and delivers professional presentations.
  
  
3. Maintains strong interpersonal relationships across diverse stakeholder groups.
  
  
Training Education Development — Intermediate to Advanced
  
  
1. Designs tailored compliance training programs for all workforce levels.
  
  
2. Assesses training effectiveness and adjusts content to address knowledge gaps.
  
  
3. Promotes consistent awareness of compliance responsibilities.
  
  
Project Program Management — Intermediate to Advanced
  
  
1. Manages multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  
  
2. Develops strategic and operational plans for the Compliance Program.
  
  
3. Implements structured processes for tracking progress and outcomes.
  
  
Risk Management Continuous Improvement — Advanced
  
  
1. Conducts comprehensive risk assessments and ongoing monitoring activities.
  
  
2. Identifies compliance vulnerabilities and implements preventative strategies.
  
  
3. Leads continuous improvement efforts across systems, policies, and internal controls.
  
  
Technical Systems Proficiency — Intermediate
  
  
1. Utilizes compliance software, databases, and Microsoft Office applications effectively.
  
  
2. Works collaboratively with IT and privacy teams to support data security practices.
  
  
3. Applies technology solutions to enhance documentation, reporting, and workflow efficiency.
  
  
PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS
  
  
In performance of their respective tasks and duties, an employee of Laguna Healthcare Corporation is expected to conform to the following:
  
  
1. Fully uphold all principles of confidentiality and patient care.
  
  
2. Adhere to all professional and ethical behavior standards of the healthcare industry.
  
  
3. Maintain all licensures and certifications required of position.
  
  
4. Interact in an honest, trustworthy and respectful manner with patients, employees, visitors and vendors.

**Position Overview:**

Reporting to the VP Quality Regulatory Affairs, the Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance will be tasked with ensuring Quality standards are met or exceeded in all facets of the multi-site operation. He/she will partner internally in the development and implementation of new or adjusted quality standards, policies, and procedures, as required at Kingwood, TX and Scottsdale, AZ.

**You’ll like this role if:**

* You enjoy leading a team, solving complex quality challenges, and turning data into practical improvements. You take ownership of compliance and thrive in a hands-on role supporting quality standards across multiple sites.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* Medium sized company – not too big, not too small – just enough to get things done and see your impact.

**Who you’ll work with:**

* You’ll report to the VP of Quality & Regulatory Affairs and lead Quality Associates supporting our Kingwood, TX and Scottsdale, AZ operations.
* You’ll partner closely with QRA, Sourcing, Distribution, and Production teams to strengthen quality systems and drive continuous improvement.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Act as the site’s Sr. Quality and Compliance Leader, and when necessary, as the site’s Designated Management Representative to ensure compliance with all regulatory, corporate and facility requirements.
* Ensure compliance of two sites.
* Ensure outstanding Quality System performance via monitoring and measuring of process performance, and driving any appropriate action, including issuing and follow-up on activities required for sourcing, warehousing, and distributing pharmaceuticals.
* Supervise & Manage Quality Associates and develop culture of collaboration and cross-functional success within the department and business.
* Reviews and monitors Quality metrics and reports trends, to determine if there is a need to escalate issues to the management.
* Perform, review and monitor the Quality Management processes which include but is not limited to:
  + Ensure compliance with FDA, DEA and BOP requirements, including DSCSA traceability of pharmaceuticals.
  + Oversee Regulatory activities associated with distribution licensing, drug distribution reports, and permits for warehousing and distribution of controlled substances.
  + inspection and product release, label approval, calibration, warehousing controls, record retention, document control, training, control of non-conforming product, quarantined Products, control of access and drugs storage, including temperature monitoring.
  + Host and manage internal and external audits. Ensure the site’s readiness for assessments and lead implementation of corrective actions.
  + Effectively assess processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
  + Review, Analyze and Report Statistical findings through critical thought and storytelling of key findings and opportunities to all levels within a matrixed organization.
  + Partner with other departments to identify critical to quality metrics, and support the operationalization of monitoring and management to deliver improved performance across processes.
  + Create effective and compelling visual materials/presentations that support the process/product improvement impact to the organization and adequately represent the impact to quality, cost and time.
  + Define, track, and monitor key success measures associated with Quality Management Systems. Successfully deploy and support change management and appropriate training plans.
* Manage document control functions, including creation, review, and approval of procedures, work instructions and all other documentation for the Quality System.
* Manage the complaint handling system, including trending and review to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Manage the training of the Site, by maintaining the training log, tracking training completion of training by site personnel, creating training content and hosting group training as needed.
* Develop and host the Quarterly Management Review
* Manage the Recall process, from notification, tracking responses & expenses, reporting, and closure.
* Develop, refine, and/or maintain quality standards, policies, and procedures for the facility, including identifying, recommending, and fully implementing changes, in partnership with corporate QRA and local operations teams. Other duties as assigned

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in technical field.
* Minimum of 3 Years of experience managing manufacturing and/or distribution of pharmaceuticals.
* Minimum of 3 Years of experience having direct responsibility for managing a Quality group.
* Direct experience managing FDA or DEA Inspections.
* Demonstrated proficiency in verbal and written communication in English, with the ability to convey information clearly, accurately, and professionally across all levels of the organization.

**Travel Requirements**

* Up to 15%

**Work Environment:**

**Office Environment**

This position is based in an office environment and is primarily sedentary in nature. It requires regular use of standard office equipment, including computers, phones, photocopiers, scanners, filing cabinets, and fax machines. Some roles may involve wearing a headset and sustained computer use for 8 or more hours per day. Employees may be required to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods, and occasional bending, lifting, or carrying items up to 50 pounds may be necessary.

**Manufacturing/Distribution Environment**

This position operates in a manufacturing plant environment. The role routinely involves working around machinery, equipment, and moving mechanical parts. The facility may be subject to varying temperatures, loud noise levels, and airborne particles such as dust or chemical fumes, depending on the area of the plant. This role may require periods of standing, sitting, or walking throughout the workday. Occasional bending, lifting, or carrying items up to 50 pounds may be necessary.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, control, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk. Hearing abilities required for this environment include being able to clearly hear and respond to audible alarms, production equipment, forklifts, and other machinery to maintain a safe work environment. Individuals must be able to distinguish and understand verbal communication including instructions, safety warnings, and team discussions, sometimes in an environment with moderate to high background noise.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

  
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

**Role Summary**

Parklane is opening a brand-new manufacturing facility in Michigan, and we are looking for a Plant Manager to work with us to build it from the ground up. As the senior leader on site, you will have accountability for the plant: safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, and culture. You will lead a team of up to 150 employees and be supported by Parklane’s shared services groups, including Engineering, Supply Chain, Human Resources, and Finance, so you can focus on running a safe, high-performing operation and setting the standard for how Parklane operates in Michigan.

**Key Responsibilities**

Site Leadership & Start-Up

* Own the overall performance of the Michigan facility, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, and cost
* Lead the ramp-up of the new site, establishing operating rhythms, processes, and standards aligned with Parklane’s practices
* Develop and execute site plans and budgets in partnership with Finance and senior leadership
* Serve as the face of Parklane in the local community, with customers, vendors, and regulators

Operations & Production

* Direct day-to-day manufacturing, fabrication, assembly, and shipping activities to meet customer commitments
* Work with production scheduling and Supply Chain to balance capacity, labor, and material availability
* Drive continuous improvement and lean practices to improve throughput, reduce waste, and control cost
* Track and report on site KPIs, and act quickly on gaps to plan

Safety, Quality & Compliance

* Champion a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements
* Partner with QHSE to implement and sustain Parklane’s quality management system and drive corrective actions to closure
* Maintain a clean, organized, audit-ready facility and well-maintained equipment

People Leadership

* Recruit, develop, and lead plant leaders, supervisors, and front-line teams, building a strong bench for a growing site
* Partner with Human Resources on hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and engagement
* Set clear expectations, coach for accountability, and recognize results in line with Parklane’s core values
* Build a positive, inclusive culture where employees feel safe, respected, and invested in the site’s success

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Engineering on product design, manufacturability, and technical issues
* Partner with Supply Chain on procurement, inventory, logistics, and supplier performance
* Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, cost control, and financial reporting
* Leverage shared services across the organization to support the site efficiently, and provide feedback to continuously improve that support

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 8+ years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including 3+ years in a plant management or senior site leadership role
* Proven experience leading a workforce of 100+ in a manufacturing or fabrication environment
* Experience launching, expanding, or transforming a facility is a strong asset
* Strong working knowledge of lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and quality systems (ISO 9001 exposure preferred)
* Solid understanding of OSHA and workplace safety, environmental, and employment regulations in the U.S.
* Financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L awareness, and cost management
* Experience with ERP systems and data-driven performance management (D365 an asset)
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills, with the ability to influence across a matrixed organization
* Hands-on, accountable, and comfortable building structure in a fast-paced, evolving environment

**About Parklane**

As one of North America’s leading providers of turnkey mechanical noise control and VIRS solutions, Parklane is on a constant search for top industry talent. Every day we help clients with their sound attenuation and vibration challenges. We do it by leveraging an agile approach to engineering, product manufacturing and implementation.

As an organization, we live and breathe our core values:

1. Challenge Accepted

2. Work Hard & Play Hard

3. Share the Wins & Own the Losses, and

4. Build Together, Grow Together

By sharing ideas and supporting each other at every turn, we’ve built a reputation both for service excellence and the strength of our workplace culture. Put simply, our team is committed to doing whatever it takes to help our customers succeed—and that’s why we need professionals with the experience and expertise to solve complex problems.

Pay: $125,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

protected_roles.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Customer Quality Manager to join our team in Charleston, South Carolina. This is an on-site position based in Charleston, South Carolina. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager of Customer Quality serves as the primary quality liaison between Elevate Aircraft Seating's manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring effective communication, timely resolution of quality issues, and alignment with customer and regulatory requirements. This highly visible, customer-facing position is responsible for leading defect investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action coordination while driving quality improvements back into manufacturing operations to prevent recurring issues and strengthen product conformity. The Senior Manager of Customer Quality partners cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and customer stakeholders to drive accountability, proactively address quality concerns, and strengthen customer relationships. This position also provides executive leadership with data-driven reporting on quality performance, emerging risks, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to support informed decision-making and operational excellence.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential*

**Customer Quality Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Elevate manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring alignment on quality concerns, operational priorities, and resolution activities.
* Lead customer-facing quality discussions, providing technically accurate information, objective evidence, and clear communication regarding product conformity, nonconformances, and corrective actions.
* Establish and maintain structured communication cadences with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely escalation, consistent messaging, and accountability for quality-related issues.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement, effective problem-solving, and timely resolution of quality concerns.

**Defect Management & Technical Quality Assurance**

* Lead the investigation, documentation, and resolution of product defects and nonconformances, identifying root causes, points of origin, and appropriate corrective actions across manufacturing, receiving inspection, and final assembly operations.
* Evaluate reported nonconformances against applicable Letters of Conformance (LOCs), approved craftsmanship documentation, engineering specifications, and customer requirements to ensure accurate defect classification and resolution.
* Partner with Boeing and internal Quality and Engineering teams on corrective action investigations, providing technical analysis, objective evidence, and recommendations to support effective resolution.
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of aircraft interior products, functionality, design requirements, and installation processes to effectively evaluate quality concerns and communicate technical findings.
* Coordinate appropriate inspection and acceptance testing support during aircraft installation activities, including verification of electrical connections, mechanical functionality, and applicable acceptance test procedures (ATP).

**Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure customer-facing quality activities align with applicable FAA/EASA regulations, AS9100 standards, customer specifications, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
* Maintain accurate, traceable quality documentation and defect records through established systems, including SharePoint, ensuring appropriate stakeholders have access to current information and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate the communication and implementation of applicable service bulletins, engineering changes, and product effectivity requirements across manufacturing locations, OSS, Boeing, and customers.
* Support customer quality reviews, audits, and regulatory compliance activities by providing technical documentation, investigation findings, and corrective action evidence.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive cross-functional corrective and preventive action initiatives to address customer quality concerns, eliminate recurring defects, and strengthen manufacturing process effectiveness.
* Translate customer quality feedback, defect trends, and investigation findings into actionable improvement opportunities for manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality teams.
* Apply root cause analysis, statistical methods, and structured problem-solving techniques to validate defect origins, assess corrective action effectiveness, and support sustainable improvements.
* Identify emerging quality risks and recurring issues, proactively escalating concerns and coordinating mitigation activities to minimize customer impact and prevent recurrence.

**Executive Reporting & Cross-Functional Quality Performance**

* Develop and present quality performance reports, defect trends, corrective action status, and emerging risks to executive leadership, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to support operational decision-making.
* Establish and monitor key quality performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer defects, resolution timelines, recurring issues, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and OSS teams to drive accountability, coordinate issue resolution, and ensure timely implementation of quality improvements across affected operations.
* Monitor customer quality deliverables, open issues, and corrective action commitments to ensure alignment with program milestones, customer expectations, and organizational quality objectives.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, or quality management within aerospace manufacturing or a related highly regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and present quality performance metrics, defect trends, corrective action status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional quality improvement initiatives, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, and translating customer quality concerns into sustainable manufacturing improvements.
* Extensive background in defect investigations, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across manufacturing and customer operations.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a primary quality interface with customers, including managing complex quality concerns, presenting technical findings, and driving issue resolution.
* Minimum of 5 years working with aerospace quality standards, FAA/EASA regulatory requirements, product conformity, and applicable customer quality requirements.

**Skills:**

* In-depth knowledge of AS9100 standards, FAA/EASA regulations, aerospace quality requirements, product conformity, and applicable airworthiness standards.
* Strong technical understanding of aircraft interior products, manufacturing processes, installation requirements, and quality documentation, including Letters of Conformance (LOCs) and approved craftsmanship standards.
* Advanced proficiency in nonconformance management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and evidence-based defect investigation and resolution.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings, resolve customer concerns, and influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret quality data, identify trends, evaluate risks, and present actionable recommendations to executive leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, establish structured communication processes, drive accountability, and implement sustainable quality improvements without direct supervisory authority.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Familiarity with Boeing quality requirements, customer-specific specifications, craftsmanship standards, and aircraft final assembly or onsite support operations.
* Formal training or practical experience conducting customer, regulatory, or third-party quality audits within the aerospace industry.
* Working knowledge of advanced quality methodologies, including APQP, FMEA, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and AS9145 requirements.
* Proficiency in AS9102 First Article Inspection (FAI) requirements, Material Review Board (MRB) processes, and aerospace product conformity documentation.
* Knowledge of aircraft interior systems, including seating, electrical and mechanical functionality, installation processes, and acceptance testing procedures (ATP).

**Other:**

* Extended or irregular hours may be required.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.
* Elevate Aircraft Seating is an “at-will” employer; employment is at the mutual consent of both the employee and the employer, and may be terminated at will for any reason, with or without cause, at any time during employment with the Company.
